spells.name: Pulse Wave
spells.description:
Kamu melepaskan gelombang energi konkusif dalam bentuk kerucut sejauh 30 kaki. Setiap makhluk di area tersebut harus melakukan saving throw Konstitusi.

- Jika gagal, makhluk tersebut menerima kerusakan kekuatan **6d6**, terdorong hingga 15 kaki menjauhimu, dan menjadi Terbaring (Prone).
- Jika berhasil, makhluk tersebut menerima setengah dari jumlah kerusakan dan tidak terdorong maupun menjadi Terbaring.

Objek yang tidak terikat, tidak dipakai, atau tidak dipegang akan terdorong hingga 15 kaki menjauhimu. Area sihir ini tidak terhalang oleh total cover, tetapi terhalang oleh total opaque cover.

spells.name: Sending
desc: You send a short message of twenty-five words or less to a creature with which you are familiar. The creature hears the message in its mind, recognizes you as the sender if it knows you, and can answer in a like manner immediately. The spell enables creatures with Intelligence scores of at least 1 to understand the meaning of your message. You can send the message across any distance and even to other planes of existence, but if the target is on a different plane than you, there is a 5 percent chance that the message doesn't arrive.

spells.name: Sleet Storm
desc: Until the spell ends, freezing rain and sleet fall in a 20-foot-tall cylinder with a 40-foot radius centered on a point you choose within range. The area is heavily obscured, and exposed flames in the area are doused. The ground in the area is covered with slick ice, making it difficult terrain. When a creature enters the spell's area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there, it must make a dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, it falls prone. If a creature is concentrating in the spell's area, the creature must make a successful constitution saving throw against your spell save DC or lose concentration.

Selama durasi hingga 1 menit, hujan es dan salju turun di area tersebut, membuatnya menjadi area yang sangat terhalang (heavily obscured) dan memadamkan api yang terbuka.

Permukaan tanah di area ini tertutup es licin, sehingga menjadi medan sulit (difficult terrain). Ketika sebuah makhluk memasuki area sihir ini untuk pertama kalinya dalam satu giliran atau memulai gilirannya di sana, ia harus melakukan Dexterity saving throw atau akan jatuh terbaring (prone).

spells.name: Slow
desc: You alter time around up to six creatures of your choice in a 40-foot cube within range. Each target must succeed on a wisdom saving throw or be affected by this spell for the duration. An affected target's speed is halved, it takes a -2 penalty to AC and dexterity saving throws, and it can't use reactions. On its turn, it can use either an action or a bonus action, not both. Regardless of the creature's abilities or magic items, it can't make more than one melee or ranged attack during its turn. If the creature attempts to cast a spell with a casting time of 1 action, roll a d20. On an 11 or higher, the spell doesn't take effect until the creature's next turn, and the creature must use its action on that turn to complete the spell. If it can't, the spell is wasted. A creature affected by this spell makes another wisdom saving throw at the end of its turn. On a successful save, the effect ends for it.

Sasaran yang terkena efek akan mengalami hal berikut:

- Mendapat penalti -2 untuk AC dan Dexterity saving throws.
- Tidak dapat menggunakan reaction.
- Pada gilirannya, ia hanya bisa menggunakan action atau bonus action, tetapi tidak keduanya.

Makhluk yang terkena efek ini melakukan Wisdom saving throw lagi di akhir gilirannya, dan efek akan berakhir jika berhasil.

spells.name: Speak with Dead
desc: You grant the semblance of life and intelligence to a corpse of your choice within range, allowing it to answer the questions you pose. The corpse must still have a mouth and can't be undead. The spell fails if the corpse was the target of this spell within the last 10 days. Until the spell ends, you can ask the corpse up to five questions. The corpse knows only what it knew in life, including the languages it knew. Answers are usually brief, cryptic, or repetitive, and the corpse is under no compulsion to offer a truthful answer if you are hostile to it or it recognizes you as an enemy. This spell doesn't return the creature's soul to its body, only its animating spirit. Thus, the corpse can't learn new information, doesn't comprehend anything that has happened since it died, and can't speculate about future events.

spells.description:
Sebagai sebuah action, kamu memberikan semu kehidupan dan kecerdasan pada mayat pilihanmu dalam jangkauan 10 kaki, sehingga mayat tersebut bisa menjawab pertanyaanmu. Mayat tersebut harus masih memiliki mulut dan bukan merupakan undead. Sihir ini gagal jika mayat tersebut telah menjadi sasaran sihir yang sama dalam 10 hari terakhir.

Hingga sihir berakhir setelah 10 menit, kamu bisa mengajukan hingga lima pertanyaan kepada mayat tersebut. Mayat itu hanya tahu apa yang ia ketahui semasa hidup, termasuk bahasa yang ia kuasai. Jawaban biasanya singkat, samar, atau berulang, dan mayat tersebut tidak wajib memberikan jawaban jujur jika kamu bersikap memusuhi atau jika ia mengenalmu sebagai musuh.

Sihir ini tidak mengembalikan jiwa makhluk tersebut ke tubuhnya, melainkan hanya roh penggeraknya. Oleh karena itu, mayat tersebut tidak bisa mempelajari informasi baru, tidak memahami apa pun yang terjadi sejak ia mati, dan tidak bisa berspekulasi tentang kejadian masa depan.

spells.name: Speak with Plants
desc: You imbue plants within 30 feet of you with limited sentience and animation, giving them the ability to communicate with you and follow your simple commands. You can question plants about events in the spell's area within the past day, gaining information about creatures that have passed, weather, and other circumstances. You can also turn difficult terrain caused by plant growth (such as thickets and undergrowth) into ordinary terrain that lasts for the duration. Or you can turn ordinary terrain where plants are present into difficult terrain that lasts for the duration, causing vines and branches to hinder pursuers, for example. Plants might be able to perform other tasks on your behalf, at the DM's discretion. The spell doesn't enable plants to uproot themselves and move about, but they can freely move branches, tendrils, and stalks. If a plant creature is in the area, you can communicate with it as if you shared a common language, but you gain no magical ability to influence it. This spell can cause the plants created by the entangle spell to release a restrained creature.
spells.description:
Sebagai sebuah action, kamu memberikan kesadaran dan kemampuan gerak terbatas pada tanaman dalam jangkauan 30 kaki darimu, sehingga mereka bisa berkomunikasi dan mengikuti perintah sederhana. Kamu bisa bertanya kepada tanaman tentang kejadian di area sihir dalam satu hari terakhir, seperti informasi tentang makhluk yang lewat, cuaca, dan situasi lainnya.

Selain itu, kamu bisa memanipulasi lingkungan selama durasi 10 menit:
- Mengubah medan sulit yang disebabkan oleh pertumbuhan tanaman (seperti semak belukar) menjadi medan biasa.
- Mengubah medan biasa yang terdapat tanaman menjadi medan sulit, membuat akar dan dahan menghambat pengejar.

Tanaman mungkin bisa melakukan tugas lain untukmu tergantung keputusan GM. Sihir ini tidak membuat tanaman bisa mencabut akar dan berpindah tempat, tetapi mereka bisa menggerakkan dahan, sulur, dan batang dengan bebas.

Jika ada makhluk tanaman di area tersebut, kamu bisa berkomunikasi dengannya seolah-olah kalian berbagi bahasa yang sama, tetapi kamu tidak mendapat kemampuan magis untuk memengaruhinya. Sihir ini juga bisa membuat tanaman yang diciptakan oleh sihir entangle melepaskan makhluk yang terikat.

spells.name: Spirit Guardians
desc: You call forth spirits to protect you. They flit around you to a distance of 15 feet for the duration. If you are good or neutral, their spectral form appears angelic or fey (your choice). If you are evil, they appear fiendish. When you cast this spell, you can designate any number of creatures you can see to be unaffected by it. An affected creature's speed is halved in the area, and when the creature enters the area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there, it must make a wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 3d8 radiant damage (if you are good or neutral) or 3d8 necrotic damage (if you are evil). On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage.

spells.name: Stinking Cloud
desc: You create a 20-foot-radius sphere of yellow, nauseating gas centered on a point within range. The cloud spreads around corners, and its area is heavily obscured. The cloud lingers in the air for the duration. Each creature that is completely within the cloud at the start of its turn must make a constitution saving throw against poison. On a failed save, the creature spends its action that turn retching and reeling. Creatures that don't need to breathe or are immune to poison automatically succeed on this saving throw. A moderate wind (at least 10 miles per hour) disperses the cloud after 4 rounds. A strong wind (at least 20 miles per hour) disperses it after 1 round.

spells.name: Tiny Hut
desc: A 10-foot-radius immobile dome of force springs into existence around and above you and remains stationary for the duration. The spell ends if you leave its area. Nine creatures of Medium size or smaller can fit inside the dome with you. The spell fails if its area includes a larger creature or more than nine creatures. Creatures and objects within the dome when you cast this spell can move through it freely. All other creatures and objects are barred from passing through it. Spells and other magical effects can't extend through the dome or be cast through it. The atmosphere inside the space is comfortable and dry, regardless of the weather outside. Until the spell ends, you can command the interior to become dimly lit or dark. The dome is opaque from the outside, of any color you choose, but it is transparent from the inside.

- Permeabilitas: Makhluk dan objek yang sudah berada di dalam kubah saat sihir dirapal dapat keluar-masuk dengan bebas, sementara semua makhluk dan objek lain terhalang untuk masuk.
- Penghalang Magis: Sihir dan efek magis lainnya tidak dapat menembus atau dirapal melewati kubah ini.
- Lingkungan: Atmosfer di dalam ruangan terasa nyaman dan kering, terlepas dari cuaca di luar.

desc: This spell grants the creature you touch the ability to understand any spoken language it hears. Moreover, when the target speaks, any creature that knows at least one language and can hear the target understands what it says.

spells.name: Vampiric Touch
desc: The touch of your shadow-wreathed hand can siphon life force from others to heal your wounds. Make a melee spell attack against a creature within your reach. On a hit, the target takes 3d6 necrotic damage, and you regain hit points equal to half the amount of necrotic damage dealt. Until the spell ends, you can make the attack again on each of your turns as an action.
higher_level: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the damage increases by 1d6 for each slot level above 3rd.
spells.description: Sebagai sebuah action, kamu menggunakan sentuhan tangan yang diselimuti bayangan untuk menghisap energi kehidupan orang lain guna menyembuhkan lukamu. Lakukan sebuah melee spell attack terhadap makhluk dalam jangkauanmu. Jika kena, sasaran menerima **3d6** kerusakan nekrotik, dan kamu memulihkan hit points sejumlah setengah dari total kerusakan nekrotik yang diberikan. Hingga sihir berakhir (maksimal 1 menit), kamu bisa melakukan serangan ini kembali pada setiap giliranmu sebagai sebuah action. Sihir ini membutuhkan komponen verbal dan somatik.

spells.name: Water Walk
desc: This spell grants the ability to move across any liquid surface-such as water, acid, mud, snow, quicksand, or lava-as if it were harmless solid ground (creatures crossing molten lava can still take damage from the heat). Up to ten willing creatures you can see within range gain this ability for the duration. If you target a creature submerged in a liquid, the spell carries the target to the surface of the liquid at a rate of 60 feet per round.

components.materialDesc: A piece of cork.

spells.material: A piece of cork.
spells.description:
Sebagai sebuah action, kamu bisa memberikan kemampuan kepada maksimal sepuluh makhluk bersedia yang bisa kamu lihat dalam jangkauan 30 kaki untuk bergerak di atas permukaan cairan apa pun—seperti air, asam, lumpur, salju, pasir isap, atau lava—seolah-olah itu adalah tanah padat yang tidak berbahaya selama 1 jam. Perlu dicatat bahwa makhluk yang melintasi lava cair tetap bisa menerima kerusakan dari panasnya.

Jika kamu menyasar makhluk yang terendam dalam cairan, sihir ini akan membawa sasaran tersebut ke permukaan cairan dengan kecepatan 60 kaki per ronde.

spells.name: Wind Wall
desc: A wall of strong wind rises from the ground at a point you choose within range. You can make the wall up to 50 feet long, 15 feet high, and 1 foot thick. You can shape the wall in any way you choose so long as it makes one continuous path along the ground. The wall lasts for the duration. When the wall appears, each creature within its area must make a strength saving throw. A creature takes 3d8 bludgeoning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The strong wind keeps fog, smoke, and other gases at bay. Small or smaller flying creatures or objects can't pass through the wall. Loose, lightweight materials brought into the wall fly upward. Arrows, bolts, and other ordinary projectiles launched at targets behind the wall are deflected upward and automatically miss. (Boulders hurled by giants or siege engines, and similar projectiles, are unaffected.) Creatures in gaseous form can't pass through it.

Saat dinding muncul, setiap makhluk di area tersebut harus melakukan saving throw Kekuatan. Makhluk yang gagal menerima **3d8** kerusakan blunt, atau setengahnya jika berhasil.

spells.name: Arcane Eye
desc: You create an invisible, magical eye within range that hovers in the air for the duration. You mentally receive visual information from the eye, which has normal vision and darkvision out to 30 feet. The eye can look in every direction. As an action, you can move the eye up to 30 feet in any direction. There is no limit to how far away from you the eye can move, but it can't enter another plane of existence. A solid barrier blocks the eye's movement, but the eye can pass through an opening as small as 1 inch in diameter.

components.materialDesc: A bit of bat fur.

Sebagai sebuah action, kamu bisa menggerakkan mata tersebut hingga 30 kaki ke arah mana pun. Tidak ada batasan seberapa jauh mata ini bisa menjauh darimu, tetapi ia tidak bisa memasuki plane eksistensi lain. Penghalang padat akan menghalangi pergerakan mata ini, meskipun ia bisa melewati celah sekecil 1 inci.

spells.name: Banishment
desc: You attempt to send one creature that you can see within range to another plane of existence. The target must succeed on a charisma saving throw or be banished. If the target is native to the plane of existence you're on, you banish the target to a harmless demiplane. While there, the target is incapacitated. The target remains there until the spell ends, at which point the target reappears in the space it left or in the nearest unoccupied space if that space is occupied. If the target is native to a different plane of existence than the one you're on, the target is banished with a faint popping noise, returning to its home plane. If the spell ends before 1 minute has passed, the target reappears in the space it left or in the nearest unoccupied space if that space is occupied. Otherwise, the target doesn't return.
higher_level: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 5th level or higher, you can target one additional creature for each slot level above 4th.

spells.name: Black Tentacles
desc: Squirming, ebony tentacles fill a 20-foot square on ground that you can see within range. For the duration, these tentacles turn the ground in the area into difficult terrain. When a creature enters the affected area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there, the creature must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take 3d6 bludgeoning damage and be restrained by the tentacles until the spell ends. A creature that starts its turn in the area and is already restrained by the tentacles takes 3d6 bludgeoning damage. A creature restrained by the tentacles can use its action to make a Strength or Dexterity check (its choice) against your spell save DC. On a success, it frees itself.

spells.name: Blight
desc: Necromantic energy washes over a creature of your choice that you can see within range, draining moisture and vitality from it. The target must make a constitution saving throw. The target takes 8d8 necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The spell has no effect on undead or constructs. If you target a plant creature or a magical plant, it makes the saving throw with disadvantage, and the spell deals maximum damage to it. If you target a nonmagical plant that isn't a creature, such as a tree or shrub, it doesn't make a saving throw; it simply withers and dies.
higher_level: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 5th level of higher, the damage increases by 1d8 for each slot level above 4th.
spells.description:
Sebagai sebuah action, energi nekrotik menyapu makhluk pilihanmu yang bisa kamu lihat dalam jangkauan 30 kaki, menguras kelembapan dan vitalitasnya. Sasaran harus melakukan Constitution saving throw.

- Sasaran menerima **8d8** kerusakan nekrotik jika gagal, atau setengahnya jika berhasil. Sihir ini tidak berpengaruh pada undead atau construct.
- Jika sasaran adalah makhluk tanaman atau tanaman ajaib, ia melakukan saving throw dengan disadvantage, dan sihir ini memberikan kerusakan maksimal.

spells.name: Compulsion
desc: Creatures of your choice that you can see within range and that can hear you must make a Wisdom saving throw. A target automatically succeeds on this saving throw if it can't be charmed. On a failed save, a target is affected by this spell. Until the spell ends, you can use a bonus action on each of your turns to designate a direction that is horizontal to you. Each affected target must use as much of its movement as possible to move in that direction on its next turn. It can take its action before it moves. After moving in this way, it can make another Wisdom saving throw to try to end the effect. A target isn't compelled to move into an obviously deadly hazard, such as a fire or pit, but it will provoke opportunity attacks to move in the designated direction.
spells.description:
Sebagai sebuah action, kamu menyasar makhluk-makhluk pilihanmu yang bisa kamu lihat dalam jangkauan 30 kaki dan bisa mendengarmu. Setiap sasaran harus melakukan Wisdom saving throw, dan otomatis berhasil jika mereka tidak bisa terpesona. Jika gagal, sasaran terkena efek ini selama hingga 1 menit.

Sampai sihir berakhir, kamu bisa menggunakan bonus action pada setiap giliranmu untuk menentukan arah horizontal. Setiap sasaran yang terkena efek harus menggunakan sebanyak mungkin pergerakannya untuk bergerak ke arah tersebut pada giliran berikutnya, meskipun ia boleh melakukan action apa pun sebelum bergerak. Setelah bergerak, sasaran bisa melakukan Wisdom saving throw lagi untuk mengakhiri efek ini.

- Sasaran tidak dipaksa bergerak menuju bahaya yang sudah jelas, seperti api atau lubang.
- Sasaran akan memicu opportunity attack demi bergerak ke arah yang ditentukan.

spells.name: Confusion
desc: This spell assaults and twists creatures' minds, spawning delusions and provoking uncontrolled action. Each creature in a 10 foot radius sphere centered on a point you choose within range must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw when you cast this spell or be affected by it.
An affected target can't take reactions and must roll a d10 at the start of each of its turns to determine its behavior for that turn.

| d10 | Behavior |
|---|---|
| 1 | The creature uses all its movement to move in a random direction. To determine the direction, roll a d8 and assign a direction to each die face. The creature doesn’t take an action this turn. |
| 2-6 | The creature doesn’t move or take actions this turn. |
| 7-8 | The creature uses its action to make a melee attack against a randomly determined creature within its reach. If there is no creature within its reach, the creature does nothing this turn. |
| 9-10 | The creature can act and move normally. |
At the end of each of its turns, an affected target can make a Wisdom saving throw. If it succeeds, this effect ends for that target.
higher_level: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 5th level or higher, the radius of the sphere increases by 5 feet for each slot level above 4th.

spells.name: Conjure Minor Elementals
desc:
You summon elementals that appear in unoccupied spaces that you can see within range. You choose one the following options for what appears: 
- One elemental of challenge rating 2 or lower 
- Two elementals of challenge rating 1 or lower 
- Four elementals of challenge rating 1/2 or lower 
- Eight elementals of challenge rating 1/4 or lower. An elemental summoned by this spell disappears when it drops to 0 hit points or when the spell ends. The summoned creatures are friendly to you and your companions. Roll initiative for the summoned creatures as a group, which has its own turns. They obey any verbal commands that you issue to them (no action required by you). If you don't issue any commands to them, they defend themselves from hostile creatures, but otherwise take no actions. The DM has the creatures' statistics.
higher_level: When you cast this spell using certain higher-level spell slots, you choose one of the summoning options above, and more creatures appear: twice as many with a 6th-level slot and three times as many with an 8th-level slot.
spells.description:
Dengan waktu casting 1 menit, kamu memanggil elemental ke ruang kosong yang bisa kamu lihat dalam jangkauan 90 kaki. Pilih salah satu opsi berikut untuk jumlah pemanggilan:
- Satu elemental dengan challenge rating 2 atau lebih rendah
- Dua elemental dengan challenge rating 1 atau lebih rendah
- Empat elemental dengan challenge rating 1/2 atau lebih rendah
- Delapan elemental dengan challenge rating 1/4 atau lebih rendah

Makhluk yang dipanggil ramah kepadamu dan rekan-rekanmu, dan akan bertahan selama hingga 1 jam, menghilang jika hit points mereka mencapai 0 atau saat sihir berakhir.

- Roll initiative untuk para elemental ini sebagai satu grup, yang memiliki gilirannya sendiri.
- Mereka mematuhi perintah verbal darimu (tidak memerlukan action).
- Jika tidak ada perintah, mereka akan membela diri dari makhluk bermusuhan, tetapi selain itu tidak melakukan action apa pun.
- GM yang menentukan statistik makhluk tersebut.

spells.name: Control Water
desc: Until the spell ends, you control any freestanding water inside an area you choose that is a cube up to 100 feet on a side. You can choose from any of the following effects when you cast this spell. As an action on your turn, you can repeat the same effect or choose a different one.

**Flood.** You cause the water level of all standing water in the area to rise by as much as 20 feet. If the area includes a shore, the flooding water spills over onto dry land. instead create a 20-foot tall wave that travels from one side of the area to the other and then crashes down. Any Huge or smaller vehicles in the wave's path are carried with it to the other side. Any Huge or smaller vehicles struck by the wave have a 25 percent chance of capsizing. The water level remains elevated until the spell ends or you choose a different effect. If this effect produced a wave, the wave repeats on the start of your next turn while the flood effect lasts

**Part Water.** You cause water in the area to move apart and create a trench. The trench extends across the spell's area, and the separated water forms a wall to either side. The trench remains until the spell ends or you choose a different effect. The water then slowly fills in the trench over the course of the next round until the normal water level is restored.

**Redirect Flow.** You cause flowing water in the area to move in a direction you choose, even if the water has to flow over obstacles, up walls, or in other unlikely directions. The water in the area moves as you direct it, but once it moves beyond the spell's area, it resumes its flow based on the terrain conditions. The water continues to move in the direction you chose until the spell ends or you choose a different effect.

**Whirlpool.** This effect requires a body of water at least 50 feet square and 25 feet deep. You cause a whirlpool to form in the center of the area. The whirlpool forms a vortex that is 5 feet wide at the base, up to 50 feet wide at the top, and 25 feet tall. Any creature or object in the water and within 25 feet of the vortex is pulled 10 feet toward it. A creature can swim away from the vortex by making a Strength (Athletics) check against your spell save DC. When a creature enters the vortex for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there, it must make a strength saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 2d8 bludgeoning damage and is caught in the vortex until the spell ends. On a successful save, the creature takes half damage, and isn't caught in the vortex. A creature caught in the vortex can use its action to try to swim away from the vortex as described above, but has disadvantage on the Strength (Athletics) check to do so. The first time each turn that an object enters the vortex, the object takes 2d8 bludgeoning damage; this damage occurs each round it remains in the vortex.

spells.description:
Sebagai sebuah action, kamu merapal sihir ini untuk mengendalikan air yang tidak terikat di dalam area berbentuk kubus dengan sisi hingga 100 kaki. Efek ini bertahan selama hingga 10 menit. Kamu memilih salah satu efek berikut saat merapal, dan sebagai action pada giliranmu, kamu bisa mengulangi efek yang sama atau memilih efek berbeda:

- Flood: Kamu membuat permukaan air di area tersebut naik hingga 20 kaki. Jika area mencakup pantai, air akan meluap ke daratan. Di badan air yang luas, kamu menciptakan gelombang setinggi 20 kaki yang melintasi area tersebut. Kendaraan ukuran Huge atau lebih kecil yang berada di jalur gelombang akan terbawa, dan kendaraan yang terhantam memiliki peluang 25 persen untuk terbalik. Permukaan air tetap tinggi sampai sihir berakhir atau kamu mengganti efek; gelombang berulang di awal giliranmu berikutnya.
- Part Water: Kamu menciptakan parit di sepanjang area sihir, dengan air yang terpisah membentuk dinding di kedua sisinya. Ini bertahan sampai sihir berakhir atau kamu mengganti efek, lalu air akan mengisi kembali parit tersebut selama ronde berikutnya.
- Redirect Flow: Kamu membuat air yang mengalir di area tersebut bergerak ke arah pilihanmu, bahkan melewati rintangan atau mendaki dinding. Setelah air keluar dari area sihir, aliran kembali mengikuti medan. Ini bertahan sampai sihir berakhir atau kamu mengganti efek.
- Whirlpool: Membutuhkan badan air minimal 50 kaki persegi dan kedalaman 25 kaki. Kamu menciptakan pusaran air dengan lebar dasar 5 kaki, lebar atas 50 kaki, dan tinggi 25 kaki. Makhluk atau objek dalam jarak 25 kaki dari pusaran akan tertarik 10 kaki ke arahnya. Makhluk bisa berenang menjauh dengan melakukan Strength (Athletics) check melawan spell save DC milikmu.

Ketika makhluk memasuki pusaran untuk pertama kalinya dalam satu giliran atau memulai gilirannya di sana, ia harus melakukan Strength saving throw. Makhluk yang terjebak memiliki disadvantage pada Strength (Athletics) check untuk berenang menjauh. Objek yang masuk ke pusaran menerima **2d8** kerusakan blunt pertama kali setiap giliran dan setiap ronde mereka tetap di sana.

spells.name: Death Ward
desc: You touch a creature and grant it a measure of protection from death. The first time the target would drop to 0 hit points as a result of taking damage, the target instead drops to 1 hit point, and the spell ends. If the spell is still in effect when the target is subjected to an effect that would kill it instantaneously without dealing damage, that effect is instead negated against the target, and the spell ends.

spells.name: Dimension Door
desc: You teleport yourself from your current location to any other spot within range. You arrive at exactly the spot desired. It can be a place you can see, one you can visualize, or one you can describe by stating distance and direction, such as "200 feet straight downward" or "upward to the northwest at a 45-degree angle, 300 feet." You can bring along objects as long as their weight doesn't exceed what you can carry. You can also bring one willing creature of your size or smaller who is carrying gear up to its carrying capacity. The creature must be within 5 feet of you when you cast this spell. If you would arrive in a place already occupied by an object or a creature, you and any creature traveling with you each take 4d6 force damage, and the spell fails to teleport you.
spells.description:
Sebagai sebuah action, kamu melakukan teleportasi dari lokasimu saat ini ke titik mana pun dalam jangkauan 500 kaki. Kamu akan tiba tepat di titik yang diinginkan, baik itu tempat yang bisa kamu lihat, kamu bayangkan, atau kamu deskripsikan melalui jarak dan arah. Teleportasi ini terjadi seketika.

Kamu bisa membawa objek selama beratnya tidak melebihi kapasitas angkutmu. Kamu juga bisa membawa satu makhluk yang bersedia dengan ukuran setara atau lebih kecil darimu yang membawa perlengkapan hingga kapasitas angkutnya, asalkan mereka berada dalam jarak 5 kaki darimu saat kamu merapal sihir ini.

Jika kamu tiba di tempat yang sudah ditempati oleh objek atau makhluk, kamu dan makhluk yang ikut bersamamu masing-masing menerima **4d6** kerusakan kekuatan, dan sihir ini gagal melakukan teleportasi.

spells.name: Divination
desc: Your magic and an offering put you in contact with a god or a god's servants. You ask a single question concerning a specific goal, event, or activity to occur within 7 days. The DM offers a truthful reply. The reply might be a short phrase, a cryptic rhyme, or an omen. The spell doesn't take into account any possible circumstances that might change the outcome, such as the casting of additional spells or the loss or gain of a companion. If you cast the spell two or more times before finishing your next long rest, there is a cumulative 25 percent chance for each casting after the first that you get a random reading. The DM makes this roll in secret.

spells.name: Dominate Beast
desc: You attempt to beguile a beast that you can see within range. It must succeed on a wisdom saving throw or be charmed by you for the duration. If you or creatures that are friendly to you are fighting it, it has advantage on the saving throw. While the beast is charmed, you have a telepathic link with it as long as the two of you are on the same plane of existence. You can use this telepathic link to issue commands to the creature while you are conscious (no action required), which it does its best to obey. You can specify a simple and general course of action, such as "Attack that creature," "Run over there," or "Fetch that object." If the creature completes the order and doesn't receive further direction from you, it defends and preserves itself to the best of its ability. You can use your action to take total and precise control of the target. Until the end of your next turn, the creature takes only the actions you choose, and doesn't do anything that you don't allow it to do. During this time, you can also cause the creature to use a reaction, but this requires you to use your own reaction as well. Each time the target takes damage, it makes a new wisdom saving throw against the spell. If the saving throw succeeds, the spell ends.
higher_level: When you cast this spell with a 9th level spell slot, the duration is concentration, up to 8 hours.
spells.description: Kamu mencoba memikat seekor Beast yang kamu lihat dalam jangkauan. Ia harus berhasil pada Wisdom saving throw atau menjadi Charmed olehmu selama durasi. Jika kamu atau makhluk yang bersahabat denganku sedang melawannya, ia memiliki Advantage pada saving throw. Selama Beast tersebut Charmed, kamu memiliki Telepathic link dengannya selama kalian berada di Plane of Existence yang sama. Kamu bisa menggunakan link ini untuk mengeluarkan perintah ke makhluk tersebut saat kamu Sadar (tidak memerlukan Action), yang akan ia ikuti sebaik mungkin. Kamu bisa menentukan tindakan sederhana dan umum, seperti "Serang makhluk itu," "Lari ke sana," atau "Ambil objek itu." Jika makhluk menyelesaikan perintah dan tidak menerima arahan lebih lanjut, ia akan bertahan dan mempertahankan dirinya. Kamu bisa menggunakan Actionmu untuk mengambil kendali total dan presisi atas target. Hingga akhir giliranmu berikutnya, makhluk hanya melakukan Action yang kamu pilih, dan tidak melakukan apa pun yang tidak kamu izinkan. Selama ini, kamu juga bisa memaksa makhluk menggunakan Reaction, tapi ini memerlukan Reactionmu sendiri. Setiap kali target menerima Damage, ia melakukan Wisdom saving throw baru. Jika berhasil, spell berakhir.
spells.higherLevel: When you cast this spell with a 5th-­level spell slot, the duration is concentration, up to 10 minutes. When you use a 6th-­level spell slot, the duration is concentration, up to 1 hour. When you use a spell slot of 7th level or higher, the duration is concentration, up to 8 hours.

spells.name: Fabricate
desc: You convert raw materials into products of the same material. For example, you can fabricate a wooden bridge from a clump of trees, a rope from a patch of hemp, and clothes from flax or wool. Choose raw materials that you can see within range. You can fabricate a Large or smaller object (contained within a 10-foot cube, or eight connected 5-foot cubes), given a sufficient quantity of raw material. If you are working with metal, stone, or another mineral substance, however, the fabricated object can be no larger than Medium (contained within a single 5-foot cube). The quality of objects made by the spell is commensurate with the quality of the raw materials. Creatures or magic items can't be created or transmuted by this spell. You also can't use it to create items that ordinarily require a high degree of craftsmanship, such as jewelry, weapons, glass, or armor, unless you have proficiency with the type of artisan's tools used to craft such objects.
spells.description:
Dengan waktu perapalan 10 menit, kamu mengubah bahan mentah yang kamu lihat dalam jangkauan 120 kaki menjadi produk dari bahan yang sama. Contohnya, kamu bisa membuat jembatan kayu dari sekumpulan pohon, tali dari serat rami, dan pakaian dari linen atau wol. Efek ini bersifat Instan.

Kamu bisa membuat objek ukuran Large atau lebih kecil (berada dalam kubus 10 kaki, atau delapan kubus 5 kaki yang terhubung), asalkan jumlah bahan mentahnya mencukupi. Namun, jika kamu bekerja dengan logam, batu, atau zat mineral lainnya, objek yang dibuat tidak boleh lebih besar dari ukuran Medium (berada dalam satu kubus 5 kaki). Kualitas objek yang dihasilkan sebanding dengan kualitas bahan mentahnya.

- Makhluk atau item sihir tidak bisa dibuat atau diubah dengan sihir ini.
- Kamu tidak bisa membuat barang yang biasanya membutuhkan tingkat keahlian tinggi, seperti perhiasan, senjata, kaca, atau zirah, kecuali kamu memiliki kemahiran (proficiency) dengan jenis alat pengrajin yang digunakan untuk membuat objek tersebut.

spells.name: Faithful Hound
desc: You conjure a phantom watchdog in an unoccupied space that you can see within range, where it remains for the duration, until you dismiss it as an action, or until you move more than 100 feet away from it. The hound is invisible to all creatures except you and can't be harmed. When a Small or larger creature comes within 30 feet of it without first speaking the password that you specify when you cast this spell, the hound starts barking loudly. The hound sees invisible creatures and can see into the Ethereal Plane. It ignores illusions. At the start of each of your turns, the hound attempts to bite one creature within 5 feet of it that is hostile to you. The hound's attack bonus is equal to your spellcasting ability modifier + your proficiency bonus. On a hit, it deals 4d8 piercing damage.

spells.name: Fire Shield
desc: Thin and vaporous flame surround your body for the duration of the spell, radiating a bright light bright light in a 10-foot radius and dim light for an additional 10 feet. You can end the spell using an action to make it disappear. The flames are around you a heat shield or cold, your choice. The heat shield gives you cold damage resistance and the cold resistance to fire damage. In addition, whenever a creature within 5 feet of you hits you with a melee attack, flames spring from the shield. The attacker then suffers 2d8 points of fire damage or cold, depending on the model.

spells.name: Freedom of Movement
desc: You touch a willing creature. For the duration, the target's movement is unaffected by difficult terrain, and spells and other magical effects can neither reduce the target's speed nor cause the target to be paralyzed or restrained. The target can also spend 5 feet of movement to automatically escape from nonmagical restraints, such as manacles or a creature that has it grappled. Finally, being underwater imposes no penalties on the target's movement or attacks.

spells.name: Giant Insect
desc: You transform up to ten centipedes, three spiders, five wasps, or one scorpion within range into giant versions of their natural forms for the duration. A centipede becomes a giant centipede, a spider becomes a giant spider, a wasp becomes a giant wasp, and a scorpion becomes a giant scorpion. Each creature obeys your verbal commands, and in combat, they act on your turn each round. The DM has the statistics for these creatures and resolves their actions and movement. A creature remains in its giant size for the duration, until it drops to 0 hit points, or until you use an action to dismiss the effect on it. The DM might allow you to choose different targets. For example, if you transform a bee, its giant version might have the same statistics as a giant wasp.
spells.description:

Kelabang menjadi giant centipede, laba-laba menjadi giant spider, tawon menjadi giant wasp, dan kalajengking menjadi giant scorpion.

desc: You or a creature you touch becomes invisible until the spell ends. Anything the target is wearing or carrying is invisible as long as it is on the target's person.
spells.description: Sebagai 1 action, kamu atau makhluk yang kamu sentuh menjadi Tidak Terlihat selama durasi hingga 1 menit. Apa pun yang dipakai atau dibawa oleh sasaran juga ikut menjadi tidak terlihat selama benda tersebut berada pada tubuh sasaran.

spells.name: Guardian of Faith
desc: A Large spectral guardian appears and hovers for the duration in an unoccupied space of your choice that you can see within range. The guardian occupies that space and is indistinct except for a gleaming sword and shield emblazoned with the symbol of your deity. Any creature hostile to you that moves to a space within 10 feet of the guardian for the first time on a turn must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw. The creature takes 20 radiant damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The guardian vanishes when it has dealt a total of 60 damage.
spells.description:
Sebagai sebuah action, kamu memanggil pelindung spektral berukuran Large yang muncul dan melayang selama 8 jam di ruang kosong pilihanmu yang terlihat dalam jangkauan 30 kaki. Pelindung ini menempati ruang tersebut dan wujudnya samar, kecuali pedang berkilau dan perisai yang terukir simbol dewamu.

Setiap makhluk yang bermusuhan denganmu dan bergerak ke ruang dalam jarak 10 kaki dari pelindung untuk pertama kalinya dalam satu giliran harus berhasil melakukan Dexterity saving throw. Makhluk tersebut menerima **20** kerusakan radiasi jika gagal, atau setengahnya jika berhasil. Pelindung ini akan lenyap setelah memberikan total kerusakan sebesar 60.

Jika gagal, makhluk tersebut menerima **4d8** kerusakan psikis dan menjadi Tuli selama durasi hingga 1 menit (Konsentrasi).

spells.name: Hallucinatory Terrain
desc: You make natural terrain in a 150-foot cube in range look, sound, and smell like some other sort of natural terrain. Thus, open fields or a road can be made to resemble a swamp, hill, crevasse, or some other difficult or impassable terrain. A pond can be made to seem like a grassy meadow, a precipice like a gentle slope, or a rock-strewn gully like a wide and smooth road. Manufactured structures, equipment, and creatures within the area aren't changed in appearance.

The tactile characteristics of the terrain are unchanged, so creatures entering the area are likely to see through the illusion. If the difference isn't obvious by touch, a creature carefully examining the illusion can attempt an Intelligence (Investigation) check against your spell save DC to disbelieve it. A creature who discerns the illusion for what it is, sees it as a vague image superimposed on the terrain.

Dengan begitu, lapangan terbuka atau jalanan bisa dibuat menyerupai rawa, bukit, jurang, atau medan sulit lainnya yang tidak bisa dilewati. Sebuah kolam bisa tampak seperti padang rumput, tebing terlihat seperti lereng landai, atau parit berbatu tampak seperti jalanan lebar yang mulus. Struktur buatan, peralatan, dan makhluk di dalam area tersebut tidak berubah tampilannya.

Karakteristik fisik (sentuhan) dari medan tersebut tidak berubah, sehingga makhluk yang memasuki area tersebut kemungkinan besar akan menyadari ilusi ini. Jika perbedaannya tidak terasa jelas saat disentuh, makhluk yang memeriksa ilusi ini dengan teliti dapat melakukan Intelligence (Investigation) check melawan spell save DC milikmu untuk mematahkan ilusi tersebut. Makhluk yang berhasil menyadari bahwa ini adalah ilusi akan melihatnya sebagai bayangan samar yang menutupi medan aslinya.

spells.name: Locate Creature
desc: Describe or name a creature that is familiar to you. You sense the direction to the creature's location, as long as that creature is within 1,000 feet of you. If the creature is moving, you know the direction of its movement. The spell can locate a specific creature known to you, or the nearest creature of a specific kind (such as a human or a unicorn), so long as you have seen such a creature up close-within 30 feet-at least once. If the creature you described or named is in a different form, such as being under the effects of a polymorph spell, this spell doesn't locate the creature. This spell can't locate a creature if running water at least 10 feet wide blocks a direct path between you and the creature.

spells.name: Mordenkainen's Faithful Hound
spells.description:
Menggunakan 1 action, kamu memanggil seekor anjing penjaga hantu di ruang kosong yang bisa kamu lihat dalam jangkauan 30 kaki. Anjing ini akan bertahan selama durasi 8 jam, sampai kamu membubarkannya menggunakan sebuah action, atau sampai kamu menjauh lebih dari 100 kaki darinya.

- Ketika makhluk berukuran Small atau lebih besar mendekat dalam jarak 30 kaki tanpa mengucapkan kata sandi yang telah ditentukan, anjing ini akan menggonggong dengan keras.
- Pada awal setiap giliranmu, anjing ini akan mencoba menggigit satu makhluk dalam jarak 5 kaki yang bermusuhan denganmu.
- Jika serangan berhasil, ia memberikan **4d8** kerusakan tembus.

spells.name: Mordenkainen's Private Sanctum
spells.description:
Selama 10 menit proses perapalan, kamu membuat sebuah area dalam jangkauan 120 kaki menjadi aman secara magis. Area tersebut berbentuk kubus dengan ukuran minimal 5 kaki hingga maksimal 100 kaki pada setiap sisinya. Saat merapal sihir ini, kamu menentukan jenis keamanan yang diberikan, dengan memilih salah satu atau semua opsi berikut:

- Suara tidak dapat menembus penghalang di perimeter area tersebut.

Sihir ini bertahan selama 24 jam atau sampai kamu menggunakan sebuah action untuk membubarkannya.

- Tingkat 5 atau lebih tinggi: Kamu dapat meningkatkan ukuran kubus sebesar 100 kaki untuk setiap tingkat slot sihir di atas tingkat 4.

spells.name: Phantasmal Killer
desc: You tap into the nightmares of a creature you can see within range and create an illusory manifestation of its deepest fears, visible only to that creature. The target must make a wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the target becomes frightened for the duration. At the start of each of the target's turns before the spell ends, the target must succeed on a wisdom saving throw or take 4d10 psychic damage. On a successful save, the spell ends.
higher_level: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 5th level or higher, the damage increases by 1d10 for each slot level above 4th.

spells.name: Polymorph
desc: This spell transforms a creature that you can see within range into a new form. An unwilling creature must make a wisdom saving throw to avoid the effect. A shapechanger automatically succeeds on this saving throw. The transformation lasts for the duration, or until the target drops to 0 hit points or dies. The new form can be any beast whose challenge rating is equal to or less than the target's (or the target's level, if it doesn't have a challenge rating). The target's game statistics, including mental ability scores, are replaced by the statistics of the chosen beast. It retains its alignment and personality. The target assumes the hit points of its new form. When it reverts to its normal form, the creature returns to the number of hit points it had before it transformed. If it reverts as a result of dropping to 0 hit points, any excess damage carries over to its normal form. As long as the excess damage doesn't reduce the creature's normal form to 0 hit points, it isn't knocked unconscious. The creature is limited in the actions it can perform by the nature of its new form, and it can't speak, cast spells, or take any other action that requires hands or speech. The target's gear melds into the new form. The creature can't activate, use, wield, or otherwise benefit from any of its equipment.

components.materialDesc: A caterpillar cocoon.

spells.material: A caterpillar cocoon.
spells.description:
Dengan menggunakan 1 action, kamu mengubah makhluk yang bisa kamu lihat dalam jangkauan 60 kaki menjadi bentuk baru. Makhluk yang tidak bersedia harus melakukan Wisdom saving throw untuk menghindari efek ini, meskipun seorang shapechanger otomatis berhasil dalam saving throw tersebut.

Transformasi ini bertahan hingga durasi maksimal 1 jam, atau sampai sasaran mencapai 0 hit points atau mati. Bentuk baru tersebut bisa berupa binatang apa saja yang Challenge Rating-nya setara atau lebih rendah dari sasaran (atau setara dengan level sasaran, jika sasaran tidak memiliki Challenge Rating). Statistik permainan sasaran, termasuk skor kemampuan mental, akan digantikan oleh statistik binatang yang dipilih, namun ia tetap mempertahankan alignment dan kepribadiannya.

spells.name: Private Sanctum
desc:
You make an area within range magically secure. The area is a cube that can be as small as 5 feet to as large as 100 feet on each side. The spell lasts for the duration or until you use an action to dismiss it. When you cast the spell, you decide what sort of security the spell provides, choosing any or all of the following properties: 
- Sound can't pass through the barrier at the edge of the warded area. 
- The barrier of the warded area appears dark and foggy, preventing vision (including darkvision) through it. 
- Sensors created by divination spells can't appear inside the protected area or pass through the barrier at its perimeter. 
- Creatures in the area can't be targeted by divination spells. 
- Nothing can teleport into or out of the warded area. 
- Planar travel is blocked within the warded area. 
Casting this spell on the same spot every day for a year makes this effect permanent.
higher_level: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 5th level or higher, you can increase the size of the cube by 100 feet for each slot level beyond 4th. Thus you could protect a cube that can be up to 200 feet on one side by using a spell slot of 5th level.

components.materialDesc: A thin sheet of lead, a piece of opaque glass, a wad of cotton or cloth, and powdered chrysolite.

spells.material: A thin sheet of lead, a piece of opaque glass, a wad of cotton or cloth, and powdered chrysolite.
spells.description:
Selama 10 menit, kamu membuat sebuah area dalam jangkauan 120 kaki menjadi aman secara magis. Area tersebut berbentuk kubus dengan ukuran minimal 5 kaki hingga maksimal 100 kaki pada setiap sisinya. Sihir ini bertahan selama 24 jam atau sampai kamu menggunakan action untuk mengakhirkannya.

Saat merapal sihir ini, kamu menentukan jenis keamanan yang diberikan dengan memilih salah satu atau semua properti berikut:

- Suara tidak bisa menembus penghalang di tepi area yang dilindungi.
- Penghalang area yang dilindungi tampak gelap dan berkabut, sehingga menghalangi penglihatan (termasuk darkvision) untuk melihat menembusnya.
- Sensor yang diciptakan oleh sihir divination tidak bisa muncul di dalam area yang dilindungi atau melewati penghalang di sekelilingnya.
- Makhluk di dalam area tidak bisa menjadi sasaran sihir divination.
- Tidak ada yang bisa berteleportasi masuk atau keluar dari area yang dilindungi.
- Perjalanan antar dimensi (planar travel) terblokir di dalam area yang dilindungi.

Merapal sihir ini di titik yang sama setiap hari selama satu tahun akan membuat efek ini menjadi permanen.

spells.name: Resilient Sphere
desc: A sphere of shimmering force encloses a creature or object of Large size or smaller within range. An unwilling creature must make a dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the creature is enclosed for the duration. Nothing-not physical objects, energy, or other spell effects-can pass through the barrier, in or out, though a creature in the sphere can breathe there. The sphere is immune to all damage, and a creature or object inside can't be damaged by attacks or effects originating from outside, nor can a creature inside the sphere damage anything outside it. The sphere is weightless and just large enough to contain the creature or object inside. An enclosed creature can use its action to push against the sphere's walls and thus roll the sphere at up to half the creature's speed. Similarly, the globe can be picked up and moved by other creatures. A disintegrate spell targeting the globe destroys it without harming anything inside it.

components.materialDesc: A hemispherical piece of clear crystal and a matching hemispherical piece of gum arabic.

spells.material: A hemispherical piece of clear crystal and a matching hemispherical piece of gum arabic.
spells.description:
Sebagai sebuah action, kamu menciptakan bola kekuatan berkilau yang mengurung makhluk atau objek berukuran Large atau lebih kecil dalam jangkauan 30 kaki. Makhluk yang tidak bersedia harus melakukan Dexterity saving throw atau akan terkurung selama durasi maksimal 1 menit.

Tidak ada yang bisa menembus penghalang ini, baik masuk maupun keluar—termasuk objek fisik, energi, atau efek sihir lainnya—meskipun makhluk di dalam bola tetap bisa bernapas. Bola ini kebal terhadap semua kerusakan, dan makhluk atau objek di dalamnya tidak bisa terkena kerusakan dari serangan atau efek yang berasal dari luar, begitu pula makhluk di dalam tidak bisa memberikan kerusakan ke luar.

Bola ini tidak memiliki berat dan ukurannya pas untuk menampung sasaran. Makhluk yang terkurung bisa menggunakan action untuk mendorong dinding bola, sehingga menggulingkan bola tersebut hingga setengah dari kecepatan makhluk tersebut. Makhluk lain juga bisa mengangkat dan memindahkan bola ini.

Sihir disintegrate yang menargetkan bola ini akan menghancurkannya tanpa melukai apa pun di dalamnya.

spells.name: Secret Chest
desc: You hide a chest, and all its contents, on the Ethereal Plane. You must touch the chest and the miniature replica that serves as a material component for the spell. The chest can contain up to 12 cubic feet of nonliving material (3 feet by 2 feet by 2 feet). While the chest remains on the Ethereal Plane, you can use an action and touch the replica to recall the chest. It appears in an unoccupied space on the ground within 5 feet of you. You can send the chest back to the Ethereal Plane by using an action and touching both the chest and the replica. After 60 days, there is a cumulative 5 percent chance per day that the spell's effect ends. This effect ends if you cast this spell again, if the smaller replica chest is destroyed, or if you choose to end the spell as an action. If the spell ends and the larger chest is on the Ethereal Plane, it is irretrievably lost.

components.materialDesc: An exquisite chest, 3 feet by 2 feet by 2 feet, constructed from rare materials worth at least 5,000 gp, and a Tiny replica made from the same materials worth at least 50 gp.

Selama peti berada di Ethereal Plane, kamu bisa menggunakan action dan menyentuh replika tersebut untuk memanggil kembali peti itu, sehingga ia muncul di ruang kosong di atas tanah dalam jarak 5 kaki darimu. Kamu bisa mengirim peti kembali ke Ethereal Plane dengan menggunakan action dan menyentuh peti sekaligus replikanya.

Efek sihir ini berakhir jika kamu merapal sihir ini lagi, jika replika peti kecil tersebut hancur, atau jika kamu memilih untuk mengakhiri sihir ini sebagai sebuah action. spells.description:
Menggunakan 1 action, cahaya kehijauan yang redup menyebar dalam bola beradius 30 kaki yang berpusat pada satu titik pilihanmu dalam jangkauan 120 kaki. Cahaya ini menyebar melewati sudut-sudut dan bertahan hingga 10 menit; kamu harus berkonsentrasi, dan efeknya berakhir jika konsentrasimu terputus. Ketika sebuah makhluk masuk ke area sihir untuk pertama kalinya dalam satu giliran atau mengakhiri gilirannya di sana, makhluk tersebut harus melakukan Constitution saving throw. Jika gagal, ia menerima kerusakan radiasi sebesar **4d10** dan menjadi Keracunan hingga akhir giliranmu berikutnya. Sihir ini membutuhkan komponen verbal dan somatik.

spells.name: Stone Shape
desc: You touch a stone object of Medium size or smaller or a section of stone no more than 5 feet in any dimension and form it into any shape that suits your purpose. So, for example, you could shape a large rock into a weapon, idol, or coffer, or make a small passage through a wall, as long as the wall is less than 5 feet thick. You could also shape a stone door or its frame to seal the door shut. The object you create can have up to two hinges and a latch, but finer mechanical detail isn't possible.

Saat merapal sihir ini, pilih tipe watcher, slicer, atau slime. Makhluk tersebut akan menyerupai aberration tipe tersebut, yang menentukan beberapa atribut tertentu dalam stat block-nya. Sihir ini memiliki durasi hingga 1 jam.

spells.name: Summon Construct
spells.description:
Kamu memanggil roh construct yang muncul di ruang kosong yang bisa kamu lihat dalam jangkauan 90 kaki. Bentuk fisik ini menggunakan stat block Construct Spirit. Saat merapal sihir ini, pilih tanah liat (clay), logam (metal), atau batu (stone); makhluk tersebut akan menyerupai construct tipe tersebut, yang menentukan beberapa atribut tertentu dalam stat block-nya.

Makhluk ini adalah sekutu bagimu dan rekan-rekanmu, dan akan menghilang jika hit points-nya mencapai 0 atau saat durasi sihir berakhir. Sihir ini bertahan hingga 1 jam. Dalam pertarungan, makhluk ini berbagi hitungan initiative yang sama denganmu, tetapi ia mengambil gilirannya tepat setelah giliranmu. Ia mematuhi perintah verbalmu (kamu tidak perlu menggunakan action). Jika tidak diberi perintah, ia akan mengambil action Dodge dan menggunakan pergerakannya untuk menghindari bahaya.

spells.name: Wall of Fire
desc: You create a wall of fire on a solid surface within range. You can make the wall up to 60 feet long, 20 feet high, and 1 foot thick, or a ringed wall up to 20 feet in diameter, 20 feet high, and 1 foot thick. The wall is opaque and lasts for the duration. When the wall appears, each creature within its area must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 5d8 fire damage, or half as much damage on a successful save. One side of the wall, selected by you when you cast this spell, deals 5d8 fire damage to each creature that ends its turn within 10 feet o f that side or inside the wall. A creature takes the same damage when it enters the wall for the first time on a turn or ends its turn there. The other side o f the wall deals no damage. The other side of the wall deals no damage.
higher_level: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 5th level or higher, the damage increases by 1d8 for each slot level above 4th.

Menggunakan 1 action, kamu menciptakan dinding api di atas permukaan padat dalam jangkauan 120 kaki. Kamu bisa membuat dinding dengan panjang hingga 60 kaki, tinggi 20 kaki, dan tebal 1 kaki, atau dinding berbentuk lingkaran dengan diameter hingga 20 kaki, tinggi 20 kaki, dan tebal 1 kaki. Dinding ini tidak tembus pandang dan bertahan hingga 1 menit.

Satu sisi dinding, yang kamu tentukan saat merapal sihir ini, memberikan kerusakan api **5d8** kepada setiap makhluk yang mengakhiri gilirannya dalam jarak 10 kaki dari sisi tersebut atau di dalam dinding. Makhluk juga menerima kerusakan yang sama saat pertama kali memasuki dinding dalam satu giliran atau mengakhiri gilirannya di sana. Sisi dinding yang lain tidak memberikan kerusakan.

spells.name: Animate Objects
desc:
Objects come to life at your command. Choose up to ten nonmagical objects within range that are not being worn or carried. Medium targets count as two objects, Large targets count as four objects, Huge targets count as eight objects. You can't animate any object larger than Huge. Each target animates and becomes a creature under your control until the spell ends or until reduced to 0 hit points. 
As a bonus action, you can mentally command any creature you made with this spell if the creature is within 500 feet of you (if you control multiple creatures, you can command any or all of them at the same time, issuing the same command to each one). You decide what action the creature will take and where it will move during its next turn, or you can issue a general command, such as to guard a particular chamber or corridor. If you issue no commands, the creature only defends itself against hostile creatures. Once given an order, the creature continues to follow it until its task is complete.
### Animated Object Statistics 
| Size | HP | AC | Attack | Str | Dex |
|--------|----|----|----------------------------|-----|-----|
| Tiny | 20 | 18 | +8 to hit, 1d4 + 4 damage | 4 | 18 |
| Small | 25 | 16 | +6 to hit, 1d8 + 2 damage | 6 | 14 |
| Medium | 40 | 13 | +5 to hit, 2d6 + 1 damage | 10 | 12 |
| Large | 50 | 10 | +6 to hit, 2d10 + 2 damage | 14 | 10 |
| Huge | 80 | 10 | +8 to hit, 2d12 + 4 damage | 18 | 6 |

An animated object is a construct with AC, hit points, attacks, Strength, and Dexterity determined by its size. Its Constitution is 10 and its Intelligence and Wisdom are 3, and its Charisma is 1. Its speed is 30 feet; if the object lacks legs or other appendages it can use for locomotion, it instead has a flying speed of 30 feet and can hover. If the object is securely attached to a surface or a larger object, such as a chain bolted to a wall, its speed is 0. It has blindsight with a radius of 30 feet and is blind beyond that distance. When the animated object drops to 0 hit points, it reverts to its original object form, and any remaining damage carries over to its original object form. If you command an object to attack, it can make a single melee attack against a creature within 5 feet of it. It makes a slam attack with an attack bonus and bludgeoning damage determined by its size. The DM might rule that a specific object inflicts slashing or piercing damage based on its form.
higher_level: If you cast this spell using a spell slot of 6th level or higher, you can animate two additional objects for each slot level above 5th.
spells.description:
Sebagai sebuah action, kamu bisa menghidupkan hingga sepuluh objek nonmagis dalam jangkauan 120 kaki, asalkan objek tersebut tidak sedang dipakai atau dibawa. Jumlah objek yang bisa kamu hidupkan tergantung pada ukurannya:
- Target Tiny dan Small dihitung sebagai satu objek.
- Target Medium dihitung sebagai dua objek.
- Target Large dihitung sebagai empat objek.
- Target Huge dihitung sebagai delapan objek.

Kamu tidak bisa menghidupkan objek yang lebih besar dari Huge. Setiap target menjadi makhluk di bawah kendalimu hingga sihir berakhir atau hit points-nya mencapai 0.

Sebagai sebuah bonus action, kamu bisa memberi perintah mental kepada makhluk hasil sihir ini jika mereka berada dalam jarak 500 kaki darimu. Kamu bisa memerintah satu atau semuanya sekaligus, menentukan aksi dan pergerakan mereka untuk giliran berikutnya, atau memberi perintah umum seperti menjaga koridor. Jika tidak diberi perintah, makhluk tersebut hanya akan membela diri. Setelah diperintah, makhluk itu akan menjalankan tugasnya sampai selesai.

Objek yang dihidupkan adalah construct dengan kecepatan 30 kaki (atau kecepatan terbang 30 kaki dengan hover jika tidak memiliki kaki). Jika terpasang kuat pada permukaan, kecepatannya adalah 0. Mereka memiliki blindsight dengan radius 30 kaki dan buta di luar jarak tersebut. Stat mereka adalah Konstitusi 10, Kecerdasan 3, Kearifan 3, dan Karisma 1. Saat objek mencapai 0 hit points, ia kembali ke bentuk aslinya, dan sisa kerusakan akan berlanjut ke objek tersebut.

Jika diperintah untuk menyerang, objek melakukan satu serangan melee slam terhadap makhluk dalam jarak 5 kaki. Bonus serangan dan kerusakan blunt ditentukan oleh ukuran:
- Tiny: +8 untuk hit, kerusakan **1d4 + 4** (AC 18, 20 HP)
- Small: +6 untuk hit, kerusakan **1d8 + 2** (AC 16, 25 HP)
- Medium: +5 untuk hit, kerusakan **2d6 + 1** (AC 13, 40 HP)
- Large: +6 untuk hit, kerusakan **2d10 + 2** (AC 10, 50 HP)
- Huge: +8 untuk hit, kerusakan **2d12 + 4** (AC 10, 80 HP)

GM dapat menentukan bahwa objek tertentu memberikan kerusakan potong (slashing) atau tembus (piercing) berdasarkan bentuknya.

spells.name: Antilife Shell
desc: A shimmering barrier extends out from you in a 10-foot radius and moves with you, remaining centered on you and hedging out creatures other than undead and constructs. The barrier lasts for the duration. The barrier prevents an affected creature from passing or reaching through. An affected creature can cast spells or make attacks with ranged or reach weapons through the barrier. If you move so that an affected creature is forced to pass through the barrier, the spell ends.
spells.description:
Sebagai sebuah action, kamu menciptakan penghalang berkilau dengan radius 10 kaki yang berpusat padamu dan ikut bergerak bersamamu selama durasi hingga 1 jam. Penghalang ini menghalangi makhluk selain undead dan construct.

- Penghalang ini mencegah makhluk yang terdampak untuk melewati atau menjangkau area di dalamnya.
- Makhluk yang terdampak tetap bisa merapal sihir atau melakukan serangan menggunakan senjata jarak jauh atau senjata dengan reach melalui penghalang ini.
- Jika kamu bergerak sehingga memaksa makhluk yang terdampak melewati penghalang, sihir ini berakhir.
spells.effectSummary: Kamu menciptakan penghalang berkilau dengan radius 10 kaki di sekitarmu yang mencegah makhluk hidup, kecuali undead dan construct, untuk masuk atau menjangkau area di dalamnya.

spells.name: Arcane Hand
desc: You create a Large hand of shimmering, translucent force in an unoccupied space that you can see within range. The hand lasts for the spell's duration, and it moves at your command, mimicking the movements of your own hand. The hand is an object that has AC 20 and hit points equal to your hit point maximum. If it drops to 0 hit points, the spell ends. It has a Strength of 26 (+8) and a Dexterity of 10 (+0). The hand doesn't fill its space. When you cast the spell and as a bonus action on your subsequent turns, you can move the hand up to 60 feet and then cause one of the following effects with it.
**Clenched Fist.** The hand strikes one creature or object within 5 feet of it. Make a melee spell attack for the hand using your game statistics. On a hit, the target takes 4d8 force damage.

**Forceful Hand.** The hand attempts to push a creature within 5 feet of it in a direction you choose. Make a check with the hand's Strength contested by the Strength (Athletics) check of the target. If the target is Medium or smaller, you have advantage on the check. If you succeed, the hand pushes the target up to 5 feet plus a number of feet equal to five times your spellcasting ability modifier. The hand moves with the target to remain within 5 feet of it.

**Grasping Hand.** The hand attempts to grapple a Huge or smaller creature within 5 feet of it. You use the hand's Strength score to resolve the grapple. If the target is Medium or smaller, you have advantage on the check. While the hand is grappling the target, you can use a bonus action to have the hand crush it. When you do so, the target takes bludgeoning damage equal to 2d6 + your spellcasting ability modifier

**Interposing Hand.** The hand interposes itself between you and a creature you choose until you give the hand a different command. The hand moves to stay between you and the target, providing you with half cover against the target. The target can't move through the hand's space if its Strength score is less than or equal to the hand's Strength score. If its Strength score is higher than the hand's Strength score, the target can move toward you through the hand's space, but that space is difficult terrain for the target.
higher_level: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 6th level or higher, the damage from the clenched fist option increases by 2d8 and the damage from the grasping hand increases by 2d6 for each slot level above 5th.

spells.description:
Sebagai sebuah action, kamu menciptakan sebuah tangan Large dari kekuatan transparan yang berkilauan di ruang kosong yang bisa kamu lihat dalam jangkauan 120 kaki. Tangan ini bertahan hingga 1 menit dan meniru gerakanmu. Tangan ini adalah sebuah objek dengan AC 20 dan hit points setara dengan maksimum hit point milikmu; sihir berakhir jika hit points tangan ini mencapai 0. Tangan ini memiliki Kekuatan 26 (+8) dan Destrezza 10 (+0), serta tidak mengisi ruang tempat ia berada.

Saat merapal dan sebagai bonus action pada giliran berikutnya, kamu bisa menggerakkan tangan ini hingga 60 kaki dan menggunakan salah satu efek berikut:

- Clenched Fist: Tangan memukul satu makhluk atau objek dalam jarak 5 kaki. Lakukan melee spell attack menggunakan statistikmu. Jika kena, sasaran menerima **4d8** kerusakan kekuatan.
- Forceful Hand: Tangan mencoba mendorong makhluk dalam jarak 5 kaki. Lakukan check Kekuatan tangan yang diadu dengan check Kekuatan (Athletics) sasaran. Kamu mendapat advantage jika sasaran berukuran Medium atau lebih kecil. Jika berhasil, sasaran terdorong 5 kaki ditambah 5 kali modifier kemampuan spellcasting milikmu.
- Grasping Hand: Tangan mencoba menangkap makhluk berukuran Huge atau lebih kecil dalam jarak 5 kaki menggunakan skor Kekuatan tangan. Kamu mendapat advantage jika sasaran berukuran Medium atau lebih kecil. Saat menangkap, kamu bisa menggunakan bonus action untuk meremukkan sasaran dengan kerusakan blunt sebesar **2d6** + modifier kemampuan spellcasting milikmu.
- Interposing Hand: Tangan tetap berada di antara kamu dan makhluk yang dipilih, memberimu half cover. Sasaran dengan skor Kekuatan kurang dari atau sama dengan Kekuatan tangan tidak bisa melewati ruang tersebut. Sasaran dengan Kekuatan lebih tinggi bisa lewat, tetapi ruang tersebut menjadi difficult terrain.

- Forceful Hand: Tangan mencoba mendorong makhluk dalam jarak 5 kaki. Lakukan check Kekuatan tangan yang diadu dengan check Kekuatan (Athletics) sasaran. Kamu mendapat advantage jika sasaran berukuran Medium atau lebih kecil. Jika berhasil, sasaran terdorong 5 kaki ditambah 5 kali modifier kemampuan spellcasting milikmu.
- Grasping Hand: Tangan mencoba menangkap makhluk berukuran Huge atau lebih kecil dalam jarak 5 kaki menggunakan skor Kekuatan tangan. Kamu mendapat advantage jika sasaran berukuran Medium atau lebih kecil. Saat menangkap, kamu bisa menggunakan bonus action untuk meremukkan sasaran dengan kerusakan blunt sebesar **2d6** + modifier kemampuan spellcasting milikmu.
- Interposing Hand: Tangan tetap berada di antara kamu dan makhluk yang dipilih, memberimu half cover. Sasaran dengan skor Kekuatan kurang dari atau sama dengan Kekuatan tangan tidak bisa melewati ruang tersebut. Sasaran dengan Kekuatan lebih tinggi bisa lewat, tetapi ruang tersebut menjadi difficult terrain.

spells.name: Awaken
desc: After spending the casting time tracing magical pathways within a precious gemstone, you touch a Huge or smaller beast or plant. The target must have either no Intelligence score or an Intelligence of 3 or less. The target gains an Intelligence of 10. The target also gains the ability to speak one language you know. If the target is a plant, it gains the ability to move its limbs, roots, vines, creepers, and so forth, and it gains senses similar to a human's. Your DM chooses statistics appropriate for the awakened plant, such as the statistics for the awakened shrub or the awakened tree. The awakened beast or plant is charmed by you for 30 days or until you or your companions do anything harmful to it. When the charmed condition ends, the awakened creature chooses whether to remain friendly to you, based on how you treated it while it was charmed.

spells.name: Cloudkill
desc: You create a 20-foot-radius sphere of poisonous, yellow-green fog centered on a point you choose within range. The fog spreads around corners. It lasts for the duration or until strong wind disperses the fog, ending the spell. Its area is heavily obscured. When a creature enters the spell's area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there, that creature must make a constitution saving throw. The creature takes 5d8 poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Creatures are affected even if they hold their breath or don't need to breathe. The fog moves 10 feet away from you at the start of each of your turns, rolling along the surface of the ground. The vapors, being heavier than air, sink to the lowest level of the land, even pouring down openings.
higher_level: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 6th level or higher, the damage increases by 1d8 for each slot level above 5th.

dc.desc: Creatures are affected even if they hold their breath or don't need to breathe.

Kabut ini menyebar melewati sudut-sudut ruangan dan bertahan hingga 10 menit, atau sampai angin kencang membuyarkannya dan mengakhiri sihir ini. Area kabut ini tergolong heavily obscured.

Ketika sebuah makhluk memasuki area sihir untuk pertama kalinya dalam satu giliran atau memulai gilirannya di sana, makhluk tersebut harus melakukan saving throw Konstitusi. Makhluk tersebut menerima **5d8** kerusakan racun jika gagal, atau setengahnya jika berhasil. Makhluk tetap terkena efek meskipun mereka menahan napas atau tidak perlu bernapas.

Kabut ini bergerak 10 kaki menjauhimu pada awal setiap giliranmu, mengalir di permukaan tanah. Karena uapnya lebih berat dari udara, kabut ini akan turun ke level terendah tanah, bahkan mengalir turun melalui lubang.

spells.name: Commune
desc: You contact your deity or a divine proxy and ask up to three questions that can be answered with a yes or no. You must ask your questions before the spell ends. You receive a correct answer for each question. Divine beings aren't necessarily omniscient, so you might receive "unclear" as an answer if a question pertains to information that lies beyond the deity's knowledge. In a case where a one-word answer could be misleading or contrary to the deity's interests, the DM might offer a short phrase as an answer instead. If you cast the spell two or more times before finishing your next long rest, there is a cumulative 25 percent chance for each casting after the first that you get no answer. The DM makes this roll in secret.

spells.description:
Dengan waktu perapalan 1 menit, kamu menghubungi dewamu atau utusan ilahi dan mengajukan hingga tiga pertanyaan yang dapat dijawab dengan ya atau tidak. Kamu harus mengajukan pertanyaan sebelum sihir berakhir setelah 1 menit. Kamu akan menerima jawaban yang benar untuk setiap pertanyaan.

Makhluk ilahi tidak selalu mahatahu, jadi kamu mungkin menerima jawaban "tidak jelas" jika pertanyaan berkaitan dengan informasi yang berada di luar pengetahuan dewa tersebut. Jika jawaban satu kata bisa menyesatkan atau bertentangan dengan kepentingan sang dewa, GM mungkin memberikan frasa pendek sebagai jawaban.

Jika kamu merapal sihir ini dua kali atau lebih sebelum menyelesaikan long rest berikutnya, terdapat peluang kumulatif 25 persen untuk setiap perapalan setelah yang pertama bahwa kamu tidak mendapatkan jawaban. GM melakukan roll ini secara rahasia.

spells.name: Commune With Nature
desc:
You briefly become one with nature and gain knowledge of the surrounding territory. In the outdoors, the spell gives you knowledge of the land within 3 miles of you. In caves and other natural underground settings, the radius is limited to 300 feet. The spell doesn't function where nature has been replaced by construction, such as in dungeons and towns. You instantly gain knowledge of up to three facts of your choice about any of the following subjects as they relate to the area: 
- terrain and bodies of water 
- prevalent plants, minerals, animals, or peoples 
- powerful celestials, fey, fiends, elementals, or undead 
- influence from other planes of existence 
- buildings For example, you could determine the location of powerful undead in the area, the location of major sources of safe drinking water, and the location of any nearby towns.
spells.description:
Dengan waktu perapalan 1 menit, kamu menjadi satu dengan alam sejenak dan mendapatkan pengetahuan tentang wilayah sekitar. Di luar ruangan, sihir ini memberimu pengetahuan tentang lahan dalam radius 3 mil darimu. Di gua atau lingkungan bawah tanah alami lainnya, radiusnya terbatas menjadi 300 kaki. Sihir ini tidak berfungsi di tempat yang alamnya telah digantikan oleh bangunan, seperti di dungeon dan kota.

Kamu secara instan mendapatkan pengetahuan hingga tiga fakta pilihanmu mengenai subjek berikut yang berkaitan dengan area tersebut:

- medan dan badan air
- tanaman, mineral, hewan, atau penduduk yang dominan
- celestial, fey, fiend, elemental, atau undead yang kuat
- pengaruh dari plane keberadaan lainnya
- bangunan

Sebagai contoh, kamu bisa menentukan lokasi undead kuat di area tersebut, lokasi sumber air minum yang aman, dan lokasi kota terdekat.

spells.name: Conjure Elemental
desc: You call forth an elemental servant. Choose an area of air, earth, fire, or water that fills a 10-foot cube within range. An elemental of challenge rating 5 or lower appropriate to the area you chose appears in an unoccupied space within 10 feet of it. For example, a fire elemental emerges from a bonfire, and an earth elemental rises up from the ground. The elemental disappears when it drops to 0 hit points or when the spell ends. The elemental is friendly to you and your companions for the duration. Roll initiative for the elemental, which has its own turns. It obeys any verbal commands that you issue to it (no action required by you). If you don't issue any commands to the elemental, it defends itself from hostile creatures but otherwise takes no actions. If your concentration is broken, the elemental doesn't disappear. Instead, you lose control of the elemental, it becomes hostile toward you and your companions, and it might attack. An uncontrolled elemental can't be dismissed by you, and it disappears 1 hour after you summoned it. The DM has the elemental's statistics.
higher_level: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 6th level or higher, the challenge rating increases by 1 for each slot level above 5th.

components.materialDesc: Burning incense for air, soft clay for earth, sulfur and phosphorus for fire, or water and sand for water.

spells.description:
Dengan waktu perapalan 1 menit, kamu memanggil seorang pelayan elemental. Pilih area udara, tanah, api, atau air yang mengisi kubus 10 kaki dalam jangkauan 90 kaki. Seorang elemental dengan challenge rating 5 atau lebih rendah yang sesuai dengan area pilihanmu akan muncul di ruang kosong dalam jarak 10 kaki dari area tersebut. Contohnya, elemental api muncul dari api unggun, dan elemental tanah muncul dari tanah. Elemental tersebut menghilang saat hit points-nya mencapai 0 atau saat sihir berakhir.

Elemental ini bersahabat denganmu dan rekan-rekanmu selama durasi sihir. Roll initiative untuk elemental tersebut, karena ia memiliki gilirannya sendiri. Ia mematuhi setiap perintah verbal yang kamu berikan (tidak membutuhkan action darimu). Jika kamu tidak memberi perintah, ia akan membela diri dari makhluk bermusuhan, tetapi tidak melakukan tindakan lain.

Jika konsentrasimu terputus, elemental tersebut tidak menghilang. Sebaliknya, kamu kehilangan kendali atasnya, ia menjadi bermusuhan terhadapmu dan rekan-rekanmu, serta mungkin menyerang. Elemental yang tidak terkendali tidak bisa dihilangkan olehmu, dan akan menghilang 1 jam setelah dipanggil.

Statistik elemental ditentukan oleh GM.
