spells.name: Primordial Ward
spells.description:
Menggunakan 1 action, kamu memberikan resistansi kepada dirimu sendiri terhadap kerusakan asam, dingin, api, petir, dan guntur. Selama sihir ini aktif:

- Jika kamu menerima kerusakan dari salah satu tipe tersebut, kamu bisa menggunakan reaction untuk mendapatkan imunitas terhadap tipe kerusakan itu, termasuk terhadap serangan yang memicu efek ini.
- Jika kamu menggunakan reaction ini, resistansi lainnya akan hilang, dan kamu memiliki imunitas terhadap tipe yang dipilih hingga akhir giliranmu berikutnya, setelah itu sihir ini berakhir.

Sihir ini memiliki jangkauan Self dan membutuhkan konsentrasi, serta akan berakhir jika konsentrasimu terputus. Durasinya adalah hingga 1 menit.

spells.name: Programmed Illusion
desc: You create an illusion of an object, a creature, or some other visible phenomenon within range that activates when a specific condition occurs. The illusion is imperceptible until then. It must be no larger than a 30-foot cube, and you decide when you cast the spell how the illusion behaves and what sounds it makes. This scripted performance can last up to 5 minutes. When the condition you specify occurs, the illusion springs into existence and performs in the manner you described. Once the illusion finishes performing, it disappears and remains dormant for 10 minutes. After this time, the illusion can be activated again. The triggering condition can be as general or as detailed as you like, though it must be based on visual or audible conditions that occur within 30 feet of the area. For example, you could create an illusion of yourself to appear and warn off others who attempt to open a trapped door, or you could set the illusion to trigger only when a creature says the correct word or phrase. Physical interaction with the image reveals it to be an illusion, because things can pass through it. A creature that uses its action to examine the image can determine that it is an illusion with a successful Intelligence (Investigation) check against your spell save DC. If a creature discerns the illusion for what it is, the creature can see through the image, and any noise it makes sounds hollow to the creature.

spells.description:
Sebagai sebuah action, kamu menciptakan ilusi berupa objek, makhluk, atau fenomena visual lainnya dalam jangkauan 120 kaki yang akan aktif ketika kondisi tertentu terpenuhi. Ilusi ini tidak terlihat sampai terpicu dan ukurannya tidak boleh lebih besar dari kubus 30 kaki. Saat merapal sihir, kamu menentukan bagaimana perilaku ilusi tersebut dan suara apa yang dikeluarkannya; pertunjukan terprogram ini dapat berlangsung hingga 5 menit.

Ketika kondisi pemicu terjadi, ilusi tersebut muncul dan beraksi sesuai deskripsi. Setelah pertunjukan selesai, ilusi itu menghilang dan tetap tidak aktif selama 10 menit sebelum bisa dipicu kembali.

Kondisi pemicu bisa dibuat umum atau mendetail, asalkan berdasarkan kondisi visual atau suara yang terjadi dalam radius 30 kaki dari area tersebut. Contohnya:
- Ilusi dirimu yang muncul untuk memperingatkan orang lain agar menjauhi pintu jebakan.
- Ilusi yang hanya terpicu ketika ada makhluk yang mengucapkan kata atau frasa tertentu.

Interaksi fisik akan mengungkap bahwa gambar tersebut adalah ilusi karena objek bisa menembusnya. Makhluk yang menggunakan action untuk memeriksa gambar tersebut dapat menentukan bahwa itu adalah ilusi dengan berhasil melakukan Intelligence (Investigation) check melawan spell save DC milikmu. Jika seorang makhluk menyadari ilusi tersebut, mereka bisa melihat menembus gambar itu dan semua suara yang dihasilkan terdengar hampa bagi mereka.

spells.name: Scatter
spells.description: Menggunakan 1 action, kamu menteleportasi setiap sasaran yang terkena efek ke ruang kosong yang bisa kamu lihat dalam jangkauan 120 kaki darimu. Lokasi tujuan yang kamu pilih harus berada di atas tanah atau lantai dan harus kosong. Makhluk yang tidak bersedia harus berhasil melakukan Wisdom saving throw untuk melawan efek ini. Efek ini terjadi seketika lalu berakhir. Sihir ini memiliki jangkauan 30 kaki dan durasi Instantaneous, serta membutuhkan komponen verbal.

Jika kena, sasaran menerima **8d8** kerusakan nekrotik, dan kamu memulihkan hit points sejumlah setengah dari kerusakan yang diberikan. Jiwa yang dicuri tetap berada di dalam sangkar sampai sihir berakhir atau sampai kamu menghancurkan sangkarnya, yang mana akan mengakhiri sihir ini. Sihir ini memiliki durasi 8 jam dan membutuhkan komponen verbal, somatik, dan material (sangkar perak kecil seharga 100 gp).

spells.name: Summon Fiend
spells.description:
Kamu memanggil roh fiend yang bermanifestasi di ruang kosong yang bisa kamu lihat dalam jangkauan 90 kaki. Wujud fisik ini menggunakan stat block Fiend Spirit. Saat merapal sihir, pilih antara demon, devil, atau yugoloth; makhluk tersebut akan menyerupai tipe fiend tersebut, yang menentukan sifat tertentu dalam stat block-nya.

Makhluk ini adalah sekutu bagimu dan rekan-rekanmu, dan akan menghilang ketika hit points-nya mencapai 0 atau saat sihir berakhir setelah maksimal 1 jam. Dalam pertarungan, makhluk ini berbagi hitungan initiative yang sama denganmu, tetapi mengambil gilirannya tepat setelah giliranmu. Ia mematuhi perintah verbalmu (kamu tidak perlu menggunakan action). Jika kamu tidak memberikan perintah, ia akan mengambil action Dodge dan menggunakan pergerakannya untuk menghindari bahaya.

spells.name: Sunbeam
desc: A beam of brilliant light flashes out from your hand in a 5-foot-wide, 60-foot-long line. Each creature in the line must make a constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 6d8 radiant damage and is blinded until your next turn. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage and isn't blinded by this spell. Undead and oozes have disadvantage on this saving throw. You can create a new line of radiance as your action on any turn until the spell ends. For the duration, a mote of brilliant radiance shines in your hand. It sheds bright light in a 30-foot radius and dim light for an additional 30 feet. This light is sunlight.

- Kamu mendapatkan 50 temporary hit points.
- Kamu memiliki advantage pada attack rolls yang dilakukan dengan senjata simple maupun martial.
- Saat kamu mengenai sasaran dengan serangan senjata, sasaran tersebut menerima tambahan **2d12** kerusakan kekuatan.
Sihir ini memiliki jangkauan Self dan membutuhkan komponen verbal, somatik, dan material (beberapa helai bulu banteng).

spells.name: Transport via Plants
desc: This spell creates a magical link between a Large or larger inanimate plant within range and another plant, at any distance, on the same plane of existence. You must have seen or touched the destination plant at least once before. For the duration, any creature can step into the target plant and exit from the destination plant by using 5 feet of movement.
spells.description: Sebagai sebuah action, kamu menciptakan hubungan magis antara tanaman tak bernyawa berukuran Large atau lebih besar dalam jarak 10 kaki dengan tanaman lain di bidang eksistensi yang sama, berapapun jaraknya. Untuk menggunakan sihir ini, kamu harus pernah melihat atau menyentuh tanaman tujuan setidaknya satu kali sebelumnya. Selama durasi 1 ronde, makhluk apa pun bisa melangkah masuk ke dalam tanaman sasaran dan keluar dari tanaman tujuan dengan menggunakan 5 kaki pergerakan. Sihir ini membutuhkan komponen verbal dan somatik.

spells.name: True Seeing
desc: This spell gives the willing creature you touch the ability to see things as they actually are. For the duration, the creature has truesight, notices secret doors hidden by magic, and can see into the Ethereal Plane, all out to a range of 120 feet.

components.materialDesc: An ointment for the eyes that costs 25gp; is made from mushroom powder, saffron, and fat; and is consumed by the spell.

spells.name: Wall of Ice
desc: You create a wall of ice on a solid surface within range. You can form it into a hemispherical dome or a sphere with a radius of up to 10 feet, or you can shape a flat surface made up of ten 10-foot-square panels. Each panel must be contiguous with another panel. In any form, the wall is 1 foot thick and lasts for the duration. If the wall cuts through a creature's space when it appears, the creature within its area is pushed to one side of the wall and must make a dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 10d6 cold damage, or half as much damage on a successful save. The wall is an object that can be damaged and thus breached. It has AC 12 and 30 hit points per 10-foot section, and it is vulnerable to fire damage. Reducing a 10-foot section of wall to 0 hit points destroys it and leaves behind a sheet of frigid air in the space the wall occupied. A creature moving through the sheet of frigid air for the first time on a turn must make a constitution saving throw. That creature takes 5d6 cold damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
higher_level: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 7th level or higher, the damage the wall deals when it appears increases by 2d6, and the damage from passing through the sheet of frigid air increases by 1d6, for each slot level above 6th.

components.materialDesc: A small piece of quartz.

spells.material: A small piece of quartz.
spells.description:
Sebagai sebuah action, kamu menciptakan dinding es pada permukaan padat dalam jarak 120 kaki. Kamu bisa membentuknya menjadi kubah hemisfer atau bola dengan radius hingga 10 kaki, atau membentuk permukaan datar yang terdiri dari sepuluh panel berukuran 10 kaki persegi. Setiap panel harus bersambungan dengan panel lainnya. Dalam bentuk apa pun, dinding ini memiliki ketebalan 1 kaki dan bertahan hingga 10 menit.

Jika dinding muncul memotong ruang yang ditempati makhluk, makhluk di area tersebut terdorong ke satu sisi dinding dan harus melakukan Dexterity saving throw. Jika gagal, makhluk tersebut menerima **10d6** kerusakan dingin, atau setengahnya jika berhasil.

Dinding ini adalah sebuah objek yang bisa dirusak dan ditembus. Dinding ini memiliki AC 12 dan 30 hit points per bagian 10 kaki, serta rentan terhadap kerusakan api. Jika bagian 10 kaki dari dinding mencapai 0 hit points, bagian tersebut hancur dan meninggalkan lapisan udara dingin di ruang yang sebelumnya ditempati dinding. Makhluk yang bergerak melewati lapisan udara dingin ini untuk pertama kalinya dalam satu giliran harus melakukan Constitution saving throw. Makhluk tersebut menerima **5d6** kerusakan dingin jika gagal, atau setengahnya jika berhasil.
spells.higherLevel: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 7th level or higher, the damage the wall deals when it appears increases by 2d6, and the damage from passing through the sheet of frigid air increases by 1d6, for each slot level above 6th.

spells.name: Wall of Thorns
desc: You create a wall of tough, pliable, tangled brush bristling with needle-sharp thorns. The wall appears within range on a solid surface and lasts for the duration. You choose to make the wall up to 60 feet long, 10 feet high, and 5 feet thick or a circle that has a 20-foot diameter and is up to 20 feet high and 5 feet thick. The wall blocks line of sight. When the wall appears, each creature within its area must make a dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 7d8 piercing damage, or half as much damage on a successful save. A creature can move through the wall, albeit slowly and painfully. For every 1 foot a creature moves through the wall, it must spend 4 feet of movement. Furthermore, the first time a creature enters the wall on a turn or ends its turn there, the creature must make a dexterity saving throw. It takes 7d8 slashing damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
higher_level: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 7th level or higher, both types of damage increase by 1d8 for each slot level above 6th.

components.materialDesc: A handful of thorns.

spells.material: A handful of thorns.
spells.description:
Sebagai sebuah action, kamu menciptakan dinding semak berduri yang kuat, lentur, dan kusut pada permukaan padat dalam jarak 120 kaki. Dinding ini bertahan hingga 10 menit dan menghalangi garis pandang. Kamu bisa menentukan panjang dinding hingga 60 kaki, tinggi 10 kaki, dan tebal 5 kaki, atau berbentuk lingkaran dengan diameter 20 kaki, tinggi hingga 20 kaki, dan tebal 5 kaki.

Saat dinding muncul, setiap makhluk di area tersebut harus melakukan Dexterity saving throw. Jika gagal, makhluk tersebut menerima **7d8** kerusakan tembus, atau setengahnya jika berhasil.

Makhluk bisa bergerak melewati dinding ini, meskipun lambat dan menyakitkan. Untuk setiap 1 kaki pergerakan di dalam dinding, makhluk tersebut harus menghabiskan 4 kaki pergerakan. Selain itu, pertama kali makhluk memasuki dinding dalam satu giliran atau mengakhiri gilirannya di sana, ia harus melakukan Dexterity saving throw. Makhluk tersebut menerima **7d8** kerusakan potong jika gagal, atau setengahnya jika berhasil.

spells.name: Wind Walk
desc: You and up to ten willing creatures you can see within range assume a gaseous form for the duration, appearing as wisps of cloud. While in this cloud form, a creature has a flying speed of 300 feet and has resistance to damage from nonmagical weapons. The only actions a creature can take in this form are the Dash action or to revert to its normal form. Reverting takes 1 minute, during which time a creature is incapacitated and can't move. Until the spell ends, a creature can revert to cloud form, which also requires the 1-minute transformation. If a creature is in cloud form and flying when the effect ends, the creature descends 60 feet per round for 1 minute until it lands, which it does safely. If it can't land after 1 minute, the creature falls the remaining distance.

components.materialDesc: Fire and holy water.

spells.material: Fire and holy water.
spells.description:
Dengan waktu casting 1 menit, kamu dan hingga sepuluh makhluk bersedia yang bisa kamu lihat dalam jarak 30 kaki berubah menjadi bentuk gas selama 8 jam, tampak seperti gumpalan awan.

Selama dalam bentuk awan, makhluk tersebut mendapatkan manfaat dan batasan berikut:
- Kecepatan terbang 300 kaki.
- Resistansi terhadap kerusakan dari senjata nonmagis.
- Satu-satunya action yang bisa dilakukan adalah Dash action atau kembali ke bentuk normal.

Kembali ke bentuk normal membutuhkan waktu 1 menit, di mana selama waktu tersebut makhluk tersebut menjadi Tidak Mampu Bertindak dan tidak bisa bergerak. Sebelum sihir berakhir, makhluk tersebut bisa kembali ke bentuk awan, yang juga membutuhkan transformasi selama 1 menit.

Jika makhluk sedang dalam bentuk awan dan terbang saat efek berakhir, ia akan turun 60 kaki per ronde selama 1 menit hingga mendarat dengan aman. Jika tidak bisa mendarat setelah 1 menit, makhluk tersebut akan jatuh dari sisa ketinggiannya.
spells.effectSummary: Mengubah dirimu dan hingga sepuluh makhluk bersedia menjadi bentuk gas menyerupai awan, memberikan kecepatan terbang yang sangat tinggi dan resistansi terhadap senjata nonmagis.

spells.name: Word of Recall
desc: You and up to five willing creatures within 5 feet of you instantly teleport to a previously designated sanctuary. You and any creatures that teleport with you appear in the nearest unoccupied space to the spot you designated when you prepared your sanctuary (see below). If you cast this spell without first preparing a sanctuary, the spell has no effect. You must designate a sanctuary by casting this spell within a location, such as a temple, dedicated to or strongly linked to your deity. If you attempt to cast the spell in this manner in an area that isn't dedicated to your deity, the spell has no effect.
spells.description:
Sebagai sebuah action, kamu dan hingga lima makhluk bersedia dalam jarak 5 kaki darimu berteleportasi secara instan ke tempat suci yang telah ditentukan sebelumnya. Kamu dan makhluk yang ikut berteleportasi akan muncul di ruang kosong terdekat dari titik yang kamu tentukan saat menyiapkan tempat suci tersebut. Jika kamu merapal sihir ini tanpa menyiapkan tempat suci terlebih dahulu, sihir ini tidak memberikan efek apa pun.

Untuk menentukan tempat suci, kamu harus merapal sihir ini di lokasi yang didedikasikan untuk atau terhubung kuat dengan dewamu, seperti kuil. Jika kamu mencoba merapal sihir ini dengan cara tersebut di area yang tidak didedikasikan untuk dewamu, sihir ini tidak akan memberikan efek.
spells.effectSummary: Berteleportasi secara instan bersama hingga lima makhluk bersedia dalam jarak 5 kaki ke tempat suci yang sebelumnya telah ditentukan dan terhubung dengan dewamu.

spells.name: Arcane Sword
desc: You create a sword-shaped plane of force that hovers within range. It lasts for the duration. When the sword appears, you make a melee spell attack against a target of your choice within 5 feet of the sword. On a hit, the target takes 3d10 force damage. Until the spell ends, you can use a bonus action on each of your turns to move the sword up to 20 feet to a spot you can see and repeat this attack against the same target or a different one.

components.materialDesc: A miniature platinum sword with a grip and pommel of copper and zinc, worth 250 gp.

spells.name: Concordant Crossing (UA)
spells.description: Kamu memindahkan dirimu secara singkat ke Astral Plane dan kembali lagi selama durasi 1 menit. Sebagai bagian dari action yang sama saat merapal sihir ini, kamu bisa berteleportasi hingga 60 kaki ke ruang kosong yang bisa kamu lihat.
spells.effectSummary: Masuk ke Astral Plane secara singkat untuk berteleportasi hingga 60 kaki ke ruang kosong yang bisa kamu lihat.
spells.fullDescription: Kamu memindahkan dirimu secara singkat ke Astral Plane dan kembali lagi selama durasi 1 menit. Sebagai bagian dari action yang sama saat merapal sihir ini, kamu bisa berteleportasi hingga 60 kaki ke ruang kosong yang bisa kamu lihat.

spells.name: Conjure Celestial
desc: You summon a celestial of challenge rating 4 or lower, which appears in an unoccupied space that you can see within range. The celestial disappears when it drops to 0 hit points or when the spell ends. The celestial is friendly to you and your companions for the duration. Roll initiative for the celestial, which has its own turns. It obeys any verbal commands that you issue to it (no action required by you), as long as they don't violate its alignment. If you don't issue any commands to the celestial, it defends itself from hostile creatures but otherwise takes no actions. The DM has the celestial's statistics.
higher_level: When you cast this spell using a 9th-level spell slot, you summon a celestial of challenge rating 5 or lower.
spells.description:
Dengan waktu casting 1 menit, kamu memanggil seorang celestial dengan challenge rating 4 atau lebih rendah, yang muncul di ruang kosong yang bisa kamu lihat dalam jangkauan 90 kaki. Celestial ini akan menghilang jika hit points-nya mencapai 0 atau ketika sihir ini berakhir setelah durasi maksimal 1 jam.

Selama durasi sihir, celestial ini bersikap ramah kepadamu dan rekan-rekanmu. Roll initiative untuk celestial tersebut, karena ia memiliki gilirannya sendiri. Ia akan mematuhi setiap perintah verbal yang kamu berikan (kamu tidak perlu menggunakan action), selama perintah tersebut tidak melanggar alignment-nya. Jika kamu tidak memberikan perintah, ia akan membela diri dari makhluk bermusuhan, namun selain itu ia tidak akan melakukan tindakan apa pun.

Statistik celestial ini ditentukan oleh GM.

- Saat serangan kena (hit), sasaran menerima kerusakan radiasi sebesar **4d12**.
- Jika kamu masih memiliki empat atau lebih bintik cahaya, mereka memancarkan cahaya terang dalam radius 30 kaki dan cahaya redup untuk tambahan 30 kaki berikutnya.

- Saat serangan kena (hit), sasaran menerima kerusakan radiasi sebesar **4d12**.
- Jika kamu masih memiliki empat atau lebih bintik cahaya, mereka memancarkan cahaya terang dalam radius 30 kaki dan cahaya redup untuk tambahan 30 kaki berikutnya.
spells.upcastEffect: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 8th level or higher, the number of motes created increases by two for each slot level above 7th.

spells.name: Delayed Blast Fireball
desc: A beam of yellow light flashes from your pointing finger, then condenses to linger at a chosen point within range as a glowing bead for the duration. When the spell ends, either because your concentration is broken or because you decide to end it, the bead blossoms with a low roar into an explosion of flame that spreads around corners. Each creature in a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on that point must make a dexterity saving throw. A creature takes fire damage equal to the total accumulated damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The spell's base damage is 12d6. If at the end of your turn the bead has not yet detonated, the damage increases by 1d6. If the glowing bead is touched before the interval has expired, the creature touching it must make a dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the spell ends immediately, causing the bead to erupt in flame. On a successful save, the creature can throw the bead up to 40 feet. When it strikes a creature or a solid object, the spell ends, and the bead explodes. The fire damages objects in the area and ignites flammable objects that aren't being worn or carried.
higher_level: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 8th level or higher, the base damage increases by 1d6 for each slot level above 7th.

spells.description:
Sebagai sebuah action, seberkas cahaya kuning melesat dari jarimu, lalu memadat menjadi bola cahaya yang melayang di titik pilihanmu dalam jangkauan 150 kaki selama durasi maksimal 1 menit. Ketika sihir ini berakhir—baik karena konsentrasimu terputus atau karena kamu memutuskan untuk mengakhirinya—bola tersebut meledak dengan raungan rendah menjadi kobaran api yang bisa merambat melewati sudut ruangan. Setiap makhluk dalam radius 20 kaki dari titik tersebut harus melakukan Dexterity saving throw. Makhluk yang gagal menerima kerusakan api sebesar total akumulasi kerusakan, sedangkan yang berhasil menerima setengahnya.

Kerusakan dasar sihir ini adalah **12d6**. Jika pada akhir giliranmu bola tersebut belum meledak, kerusakannya bertambah **1d6**.

Jika bola cahaya tersebut disentuh sebelum waktunya meledak, makhluk yang menyentuhnya harus melakukan Dexterity saving throw. Jika gagal, sihir berakhir seketika dan bola tersebut meledak. Jika berhasil, makhluk tersebut bisa melempar bola itu hingga 40 kaki. Saat bola mengenai makhluk atau objek padat, sihir berakhir dan bola tersebut meledak.

Api ini merusak objek di area tersebut dan membakar benda-benda yang mudah terbakar yang tidak sedang dipakai atau dibawa.

spells.name: Divine Word
desc:
You utter a divine word, imbued with the power that shaped the world at the dawn of creation. Choose any number of creatures you can see within range. Each creature that can hear you must make a Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, a creature suffers an effect based on its current hit points: 
- 50hp or less: deafened for 1 minute 
- 40 hp or less: deafened and blinded for 10 minutes 
- 30 hp or less: blinded, deafened and dazed for 1 hour 
- 20 hp or less: killed instantly. Regardless of its current hit points, a celestial, an elemental, a fey, or a fiend that fails its save is forced back to its plane of origin (if it isn't there already) and can't return to your current plane for 24 hours by any means short of a wish spell.

dc.desc: On a failed save, a creature suffers an effect based on its current hit points.

spells.description:
Sebagai sebuah bonus action, kamu mengucapkan kata suci yang mengandung kekuatan penciptaan dunia. Pilih sejumlah makhluk yang bisa kamu lihat dalam jangkauan 30 kaki. Setiap makhluk yang bisa mendengarmu harus melakukan Charisma saving throw. Jika gagal, makhluk tersebut menderita efek berdasarkan hit points saat ini:

- 50 hit points atau kurang: Tuli selama 1 menit
- 40 hit points atau kurang: Tuli dan Buta selama 10 menit
- 30 hit points atau kurang: Buta, Tuli, dan Pusing selama 1 jam
- 20 hit points atau kurang: Mati seketika

Terlepas dari jumlah hit points-nya, makhluk celestial, elemental, fey, atau fiend yang gagal dalam saving throw akan dipaksa kembali ke plane asal mereka (jika tidak sedang berada di sana) dan tidak bisa kembali ke plane saat ini selama 24 jam, kecuali menggunakan sihir wish.

spells.description:
Dengan sebuah raungan, kamu menggunakan sihir naga untuk mengubah dirimu selama durasi maksimal 1 menit, dan mendapatkan keuntungan berikut:

- Kamu memiliki kecepatan terbang 60 kaki.
- Kamu memiliki blindsight dengan jangkauan 30 kaki.
- Kamu mendapatkan serangan napas (kerucut 15 kaki, kerusakan **6d6**, Dexterity saving throw). Setelah menggunakan serangan napas, kamu tidak bisa menggunakannya lagi sampai kamu menggunakan bonus action untuk mengaktifkannya kembali.
- Kamu mendapatkan resistansi terhadap tipe kerusakan yang sama dengan serangan napasmu.
spells.effectSummary: Kamu mengubah dirimu menjadi avatar naga untuk mendapatkan kecepatan terbang, blindsight, resistansi kerusakan, dan serangan napas berbentuk kerucut yang kuat.

spells.name: Dream of the Blue Veil
spells.description: Kamu dan hingga delapan makhluk yang bersedia dalam jarak 20 kaki menjadi Tidak Sadar selama durasi sihir 6 jam dan mengalami penglihatan tentang dunia lain di Material Plane, seperti Oerth, Toril, Krynn, atau Eberron. Jika sihir mencapai durasi penuh, penglihatan tersebut diakhiri dengan pertemuan dengan roh pelindung yang berwujud makhluk agung seperti naga, couatl, atau ki-rin. Roh tersebut menawarkan untuk memindahkanmu dan rekan-rekanmu ke dunia yang kamu kunjungi dalam mimpi. Jika kamu menerima, kamu dan makhluk lain yang menerima tawaran tersebut akan menghilang dan tiba di dunia mimpi tersebut pada lokasi yang sama dengan tempat kamu merapal sihir. Jika kamu menolak, kamu akan terbangun dan sihir berakhir tanpa efek. Setelah sihir berakhir, kamu dan makhluk lain yang terdampak tidak bisa terkena sihir ini lagi sampai kamu menyelesaikan long rest.

spells.name: Etherealness
desc: You step into the border regions of the Ethereal Plane, in the area where it overlaps with your current plane. You remain in the Border Ethereal for the duration or until you use your action to dismiss the spell. During this time, you can move in any direction. If you move up or down, every foot of movement costs an extra foot. You can see and hear the plane you originated from, but everything there looks gray, and you can't see anything more than 60 feet away. While on the Ethereal Plane, you can only affect and be affected by other creatures on that plane. Creatures that aren't on the Ethereal Plane can't perceive you and can't interact with you, unless a special ability or magic has given them the ability to do so. You ignore all objects and effects that aren't on the Ethereal Plane, allowing you to move through objects you perceive on the plane you originated from. When the spell ends, you immediately return to the plane you originated from in the spot you currently occupy. If you occupy the same spot as a solid object or creature when this happens, you are immediately shunted to the nearest unoccupied space that you can occupy and take force damage equal to twice the number of feet you are moved. This spell has no effect if you cast it while you are on the Ethereal Plane or a plane that doesn't border it, such as one of the Outer Planes.
higher_level: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 8th level or higher, you can target up to three willing creatures (including you) for each slot level above 7th. The creatures must be within 10 feet of you when you cast the spell.
spells.description:
Sebagai sebuah action, kamu melangkah ke wilayah perbatasan Ethereal Plane di area yang tumpang tindih dengan plane saat ini. Kamu tetap berada di Border Ethereal selama durasi 8 jam atau sampai kamu menggunakan action untuk mengakhiri sihir. Selama waktu ini, kamu bisa bergerak ke segala arah; namun, bergerak naik atau turun membutuhkan tambahan 1 kaki pergerakan untuk setiap kaki yang ditempuh. Kamu bisa melihat dan mendengar plane asalmu, meskipun semuanya tampak abu-abu dan jarak pandang terbatas hingga 60 kaki.

Saat berada di Ethereal Plane, kamu hanya bisa memengaruhi dan dipengaruhi oleh makhluk lain yang juga berada di plane tersebut. Makhluk yang tidak berada di Ethereal Plane tidak bisa melihat atau berinteraksi denganmu, kecuali mereka memiliki kemampuan khusus atau sihir untuk melakukannya. Kamu mengabaikan semua objek dan efek yang tidak berada di Ethereal Plane, sehingga kamu bisa menembus objek yang kamu lihat di plane asalmu.

Ketika sihir berakhir, kamu segera kembali ke plane asalmu di posisi terakhirmu. Jika kamu berada di posisi yang sama dengan objek padat atau makhluk, kamu akan terdorong ke ruang kosong terdekat dan menerima kerusakan kekuatan sebesar dua kali jumlah kaki kamu terdorong.

Sihir ini tidak berpengaruh jika dirapal saat kamu sudah berada di Ethereal Plane atau plane yang tidak berbatasan dengannya, seperti salah satu Outer Planes.

spells.name: Finger of Death
desc: You send negative energy coursing through a creature that you can see within range, causing it searing pain. The target must make a constitution saving throw. It takes 7d8 + 30 necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A humanoid killed by this spell rises at the start of your next turn as a zombie that is permanently under your command, following your verbal orders to the best of its ability.
spells.description:
Menggunakan 1 action, kamu mengirimkan energi negatif ke makhluk yang bisa kamu lihat dalam jangkauan 60 kaki, menyebabkan rasa sakit yang luar biasa. Sasaran harus melakukan Constitution saving throw. Ia menerima kerusakan nekrotik sebesar **7d8 + 30** jika gagal, atau setengahnya jika berhasil.

Humanoid yang terbunuh oleh sihir ini akan bangkit pada awal giliranmu berikutnya sebagai zombie yang berada di bawah perintahmu secara permanen, dan akan mengikuti perintah verbalmu sebaik mungkin.
spells.effectSummary: Kamu menembakkan energi negatif ke sasaran untuk memberikan kerusakan nekrotik yang masif, dan membangkitkan humanoid yang terbunuh menjadi zombie setia.

spells.name: Fire Storm
desc: A storm made up of sheets of roaring flame appears in a location you choose within range. The area of the storm consists of up to ten 10-foot cubes, which you can arrange as you wish. Each cube must have at least one face adjacent to the face of another cube. Each creature in the area must make a dexterity saving throw. It takes 7d10 fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The fire damages objects in the area and ignites flammable objects that aren't being worn or carried. If you choose, plant life in the area is unaffected by this spell.
spells.description:

Area badai ini terdiri dari maksimal sepuluh kubus berukuran 10 kaki, yang bisa kamu susun sesukamu, asalkan setiap kubus memiliki setidaknya satu sisi yang menempel dengan kubus lainnya. Setiap makhluk di area tersebut harus melakukan Dexterity saving throw. Makhluk tersebut menerima kerusakan api sebesar **7d10** jika gagal, atau setengahnya jika berhasil.

Api ini memberikan kerusakan pada objek di area tersebut dan membakar benda-benda yang mudah terbakar yang tidak sedang dipakai atau dibawa. Jika kamu mau, tanaman di area tersebut tidak akan terpengaruh oleh sihir ini.
spells.effectSummary: Kamu menciptakan badai api raksasa di area yang bisa kamu atur bentuknya untuk membakar musuh dan benda di sekitarnya.

spells.name: Forcecage
desc: An immobile, invisible, cube-shaped prison composed of magical force springs into existence around an area you choose within range. The prison can be a cage or a solid box, as you choose. A prison in the shape of a cage can be up to 20 feet on a side and is made from 1/2-inch diameter bars spaced 1/2 inch apart. A prison in the shape of a box can be up to 10 feet on a side, creating a solid barrier that prevents any matter from passing through it and blocking any spells cast into or out from the area. When you cast the spell, any creature that is completely inside the cage's area is trapped. Creatures only partially within the area, or those too large to fit inside the area, are pushed away from the center of the area until they are completely outside the area. A creature inside the cage can't leave it by nonmagical means. If the creature tries to use teleportation or interplanar travel to leave the cage, it must first make a charisma saving throw. On a success, the creature can use that magic to exit the cage. On a failure, the creature can't exit the cage and wastes the use of the spell or effect. The cage also extends into the Ethereal Plane, blocking ethereal travel. This spell can't be dispelled by dispel magic.

spells.description:
Sebagai sebuah action, kamu menciptakan penjara berbentuk kubus yang tidak bisa dipindahkan dan tidak terlihat, terbuat dari kekuatan magis dalam jangkauan 100 kaki. Penjara ini bertahan selama 1 jam dan bisa dibuat dalam salah satu dari dua bentuk:

- Kandang: Ukuran maksimal 20 kaki di setiap sisinya, terdiri dari jeruji berdiameter 1/2 inci dengan jarak antar jeruji 1/2 inci.
- Kotak padat: Ukuran maksimal 10 kaki di setiap sisinya, menciptakan penghalang padat yang mencegah benda apa pun lewat dan memblokir semua sihir yang dilemparkan ke dalam atau ke luar area tersebut.

Saat kamu merapal sihir ini, makhluk apa pun yang berada sepenuhnya di dalam area tersebut akan terperangkap. Makhluk yang hanya berada sebagian di dalam area, atau yang terlalu besar untuk masuk, akan terdorong menjauh dari pusat hingga mereka berada sepenuhnya di luar.

Makhluk di dalam kandang tidak bisa keluar dengan cara non-magis. Jika makhluk mencoba menggunakan teleportasi atau perjalanan antar-dimensi untuk keluar, ia harus melakukan Charisma saving throw. Jika berhasil, makhluk tersebut keluar dari kandang; jika gagal, ia tetap terperangkap dan membuang penggunaan sihir atau efek tersebut. Kandang ini juga meluas hingga ke Ethereal Plane, sehingga memblokir perjalanan etereal. Sihir ini tidak bisa dihilangkan dengan dispel magic.

spells.name: Magnificent Mansion
desc: You conjure an extradimensional dwelling in range that lasts for the duration. You choose where its one entrance is located. The entrance shimmers faintly and is 5 feet wide and 10 feet tall. You and any creature you designate when you cast the spell can enter the extradimensional dwelling as long as the portal remains open. You can open or close the portal if you are within 30 feet of it. While closed, the portal is invisible. Beyond the portal is a magnificent foyer with numerous chambers beyond. The atmosphere is clean, fresh, and warm. You can create any floor plan you like, but the space can't exceed 50 cubes, each cube being 10 feet on each side. The place is furnished and decorated as you choose. It contains sufficient food to serve a nine course banquet for up to 100 people. A staff of 100 near-transparent servants attends all who enter. You decide the visual appearance of these servants and their attire. They are completely obedient to your orders. Each servant can perform any task a normal human servant could perform, but they can't attack or take any action that would directly harm another creature. Thus the servants can fetch things, clean, mend, fold clothes, light fires, serve food, pour wine, and so on. The servants can go anywhere in the mansion but can't leave it. Furnishings and other objects created by this spell dissipate into smoke if removed from the mansion. When the spell ends, any creatures inside the extradimensional space are expelled into the open spaces nearest to the entrance.

components.materialDesc: A miniature portal carved from ivory, a small piece of polished marble, and a tiny silver spoon, each item worth at least 5 gp.

spells.description:
Dengan waktu perapalan 1 menit, kamu memanggil kediaman ekstradimensional dalam jangkauan 300 kaki yang bertahan selama 24 jam. Kamu menentukan lokasi satu-satunya pintu masuk, yang lebarnya 5 kaki dan tingginya 10 kaki. Kamu dan makhluk lain yang kamu tunjuk saat merapal sihir ini dapat memasuki kediaman tersebut selama portal terbuka. Kamu bisa membuka atau menutup portal jika berada dalam jarak 30 kaki; saat tertutup, portal tersebut tidak terlihat.

Di balik portal terdapat foyer megah dengan banyak ruangan. Kamu bisa membuat denah lantai sesukamu, asalkan luasnya tidak melebihi 50 kubus (masing-masing 10 kaki di setiap sisinya). Rumah mewah ini dilengkapi furnitur dan dekorasi sesuai keinginanmu, serta menyediakan makanan yang cukup untuk perjamuan sembilan menu bagi maksimal 100 orang.

Staf yang terdiri dari 100 pelayan semi-transparan, yang penampilan dan pakaiannya kamu tentukan, akan melayani semua yang masuk. Para pelayan ini sepenuhnya patuh dan bisa melakukan tugas apa pun yang bisa dilakukan pelayan manusia normal, seperti mengambil barang, membersihkan, menjahit, melipat pakaian, menyalakan api, menyajikan makanan, dan menuangkan anggur. Namun, mereka tidak bisa menyerang atau melakukan action apa pun yang secara langsung membahayakan makhluk lain. Pelayan bisa pergi ke mana saja di dalam rumah mewah tersebut tetapi tidak bisa keluar.

Furnitur dan objek lain yang diciptakan oleh sihir ini akan lenyap menjadi asap jika dikeluarkan dari rumah mewah tersebut. Saat sihir berakhir, semua makhluk di dalam ruang ekstradimensional akan terlempar ke area terbuka terdekat dari pintu masuk.

spells.name: Mirage Arcane
desc: You make terrain in an area up to 1 mile square look, sound, smell, and even feel like some other sort of terrain. The terrain's general shape remains the same, however. Open fields or a road could be made to resemble a swamp, hill, crevasse, or some other difficult or impassable terrain. A pond can be made to seem like a grassy meadow, a precipice like a gentle slope, or a rock-strewn gully like a wide and smooth road. Similarly, you can alter the appearance of structures, or add them where none are present. The spell doesn't disguise, conceal, or add creatures. The illusion includes audible, visual, tactile, and olfactory elements, so it can turn clear ground into difficult terrain (or vice versa) or otherwise impede movement through the area. Any piece of the illusory terrain (such as a rock or stick) that is removed from the spell's area disappears immediately. Creatures with truesight can see through the illusion to the terrain's true form; however, all other elements of the illusion remain, so while the creature is aware of the illusion's presence, the creature can still physically interact with the illusion.
spells.description:
Selama 10 menit, kamu membuat medan di area hingga 1 mil persegi yang terlihat olehmu tampak, terdengar, tercium, dan bahkan terasa seperti jenis medan lain selama durasi 10 hari. Meskipun bentuk umum medannya tetap sama, kamu bisa membuat lapangan terbuka atau jalanan terlihat seperti rawa, bukit, celah, atau medan sulit lainnya yang tidak bisa dilewati. Sebaliknya, sebuah kolam bisa tampak seperti padang rumput, tebing tampak seperti lereng landai, atau parit berbatu tampak seperti jalan lebar yang mulus.

Kamu juga bisa mengubah tampilan bangunan atau menambahkannya di tempat yang sebelumnya tidak ada, meskipun sihir ini tidak bisa menyamarkan, menyembunyikan, atau menambahkan makhluk.

Ilusi ini mencakup elemen suara, visual, sentuhan, dan penciuman, sehingga bisa mengubah tanah datar menjadi medan sulit (atau sebaliknya) atau menghambat pergerakan. Bagian apa pun dari medan ilusi, seperti batu atau ranting, akan segera lenyap jika dipindahkan dari area sihir.

Makhluk dengan truesight bisa melihat menembus ilusi tersebut ke bentuk medan yang asli; namun, semua elemen ilusi lainnya tetap ada, artinya makhluk tersebut sadar akan ilusi itu tetapi masih bisa berinteraksi secara fisik dengannya.

spells.name: Plane Shift
desc: You and up to eight willing creatures who link hands in a circle are transported to a different plane of existence. You can specify a target destination in general terms, such as the City of Brass on the Elemental Plane of Fire or the palace of Dispater on the second level of the Nine Hells, and you appear in or near that destination. If you are trying to reach the City of Brass, for example, you might arrive in its Street of Steel, before its Gate of Ashes, or looking at the city from across the Sea of Fire, at the DM's discretion. Alternatively, if you know the sigil sequence of a teleportation circle on another plane of existence, this spell can take you to that circle. If the teleportation circle is too small to hold all the creatures you transported, they appear in the closest unoccupied spaces next to the circle. You can use this spell to banish an unwilling creature to another plane. Choose a creature within your reach and make a melee spell attack against it. On a hit, the creature must make a charisma saving throw. If the creature fails this save, it is transported to a random location on the plane of existence you specify. A creature so transported must find its own way back to your current plane of existence.

spells.description:
Sebagai sebuah action, kamu dan hingga delapan makhluk sukarela yang saling berpegangan tangan dalam lingkaran akan berpindah ke bidang eksistensi yang berbeda. Kamu bisa menentukan tujuan secara umum, dan kamu akan muncul di atau dekat tujuan tersebut sesuai keputusan GM. Alternatifnya, jika kamu mengetahui urutan sigil dari lingkaran teleportasi di bidang eksistensi lain, sihir ini bisa membawamu ke lingkaran tersebut; jika lingkarannya terlalu kecil, makhluk-makhluk akan muncul di ruang kosong terdekat di sampingnya.

Kamu juga bisa menggunakan sihir ini untuk membuang makhluk yang tidak mau ke bidang lain. Pilih satu makhluk dalam jangkauan sentuhanmu dan lakukan melee spell attack terhadapnya. Jika serangan kena, makhluk tersebut harus melakukan Charisma saving throw. Jika gagal, ia akan terlempar ke lokasi acak di bidang eksistensi yang kamu tentukan dan harus mencari jalan kembali sendiri ke bidangmu saat ini.

spells.name: Prismatic Spray
desc: Eight multicolored rays of light flash from your hand. Each ray is a different color and has a different power and purpose. Each creature in a 60-foot cone must make a dexterity saving throw. For each target, roll a d8 to determine which color ray affects it.
**1. Red.** The target takes 10d6 fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
**2. Orange.** The target takes 10d6 acid damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
**3. Yellow.** The target takes 10d6 lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
**4. Green.** The target takes 10d6 poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
**5. Blue.** The target takes 10d6 cold damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

**6. Indigo.** On a failed save, the target is restrained. It must then make a constitution saving throw at the end of each of its turns. If it successfully saves three times, the spell ends. If it fails its save three times, it permanently turns to stone and is subjected to the petrified condition. The successes and failures don't need to be consecutive; keep track of both until the target collects three of a kind.

**7. Violet.** On a failed save, the target is blinded. It must then make a wisdom saving throw at the start of your next turn. A successful save ends the blindness. If it fails that save, the creature is transported to another plane of existence of the DM's choosing and is no longer blinded. (Typically, a creature that is on a plane that isn't its home plane is banished home, while other creatures are usually cast into the Astral or Ethereal planes.)
**8. Special.** The target is struck by two rays. Roll twice more, rerolling any 8.

dc.desc: For each target, roll a d8 to determine which color ray affects it.

spells.description:
Sebagai sebuah action, delapan sinar cahaya warna-warni memancar dari tanganmu. Setiap makhluk dalam kerucut 60 kaki harus melakukan Dexterity saving throw. Untuk setiap sasaran, roll sebuah d8 untuk menentukan warna sinar mana yang mengenainya:

- Merah: Sasaran menerima kerusakan api **10d6** jika gagal, atau setengahnya jika berhasil.
- Oranye: Sasaran menerima kerusakan asam **10d6** jika gagal, atau setengahnya jika berhasil.
- Kuning: Sasaran menerima kerusakan petir **10d6** jika gagal, atau setengahnya jika berhasil.
- Hijau: Sasaran menerima kerusakan racun **10d6** jika gagal, atau setengahnya jika berhasil.
- Biru: Sasaran menerima kerusakan dingin **10d6** jika gagal, atau setengahnya jika berhasil.
- Indigo: Jika gagal, sasaran menjadi terikat (restrained). Ia harus melakukan Constitution saving throw di akhir setiap gilirannya. Jika berhasil tiga kali, sihir berakhir. Jika gagal tiga kali, ia berubah menjadi batu secara permanen dan terkena kondisi lumpuh (petrified).
- Violet: Jika gagal, sasaran menjadi Buta. Ia harus melakukan Wisdom saving throw di awal giliranmu berikutnya. Jika berhasil, kebutaan berakhir. Jika gagal, makhluk tersebut terlempar ke bidang eksistensi lain pilihan GM dan tidak lagi Buta.
- Spesial: Sasaran terkena dua sinar. Roll dua kali lagi, dan ulangi jika mendapatkan angka 8.

spells.name: Project Image
desc: You create an illusory copy of yourself that lasts for the duration. The copy can appear at any location within range that you have seen before, regardless of intervening obstacles. The illusion looks and sounds like you but is intangible. If the illusion takes any damage, it disappears, and the spell ends. You can use your action to move this illusion up to twice your speed, and make it gesture, speak, and behave in whatever way you choose. It mimics your mannerisms perfectly. You can see through its eyes and hear through its ears as if you were in its space. On your turn as a bonus action, you can switch from using its senses to using your own, or back again. While you are using its senses, you are blinded and deafened in regard to your own surroundings. Physical interaction with the image reveals it to be an illusion, because things can pass through it. A creature that uses its action to examine the image can determine that it is an illusion with a successful Intelligence (Investigation) check against your spell save DC. If a creature discerns the illusion for what it is, the creature can see through the image, and any noise it makes sounds hollow to the creature.

spells.name: Regenerate
desc: You touch a creature and stimulate its natural healing ability. The target regains 4d8 + 15 hit points. For the duration of the spell, the target regains 1 hit point at the start of each of its turns (10 hit points each minute). The target's severed body members (fingers, legs, tails, and so on), if any, are restored after 2 minutes. If you have the severed part and hold it to the stump, the spell instantaneously causes the limb to knit to the stump.

spells.name: Resurrection
desc: You touch a dead creature that has been dead for no more than a century, that didn't die of old age, and that isn't undead. If its soul is free and willing, the target returns to life with all its hit points. This spell neutralizes any poisons and cures normal diseases afflicting the creature when it died. It doesn't, however, remove magical diseases, curses, and the like; if such effects aren't removed prior to casting the spell, they afflict the target on its return to life. This spell closes all mortal wounds and restores any missing body parts. Coming back from the dead is an ordeal. The target takes a -4 penalty to all attack rolls, saving throws, and ability checks. Every time the target finishes a long rest, the penalty is reduced by 1 until it disappears. Casting this spell to restore life to a creature that has been dead for one year or longer taxes you greatly. Until you finish a long rest, you can't cast spells again, and you have disadvantage on all attack rolls, ability checks, and saving throws.

desc: This spell reverses gravity in a 50-foot-radius, 100-foot high cylinder centered on a point within range. All creatures and objects that aren't somehow anchored to the ground in the area fall upward and reach the top of the area when you cast this spell. A creature can make a dexterity saving throw to grab onto a fixed object it can reach, thus avoiding the fall. If some solid object (such as a ceiling) is encountered in this fall, falling objects and creatures strike it just as they would during a normal downward fall. If an object or creature reaches the top of the area without striking anything, it remains there, oscillating slightly, for the duration. At the end of the duration, affected objects and creatures fall back down.

spells.name: Sequester
desc: By means of this spell, a willing creature or an object can be hidden away, safe from detection for the duration. When you cast the spell and touch the target, it becomes invisible and can't be targeted by divination spells or perceived through scrying sensors created by divination spells. If the target is a creature, it falls into a state of suspended animation. Time ceases to flow for it, and it doesn't grow older. You can set a condition for the spell to end early. The condition can be anything you choose, but it must occur or be visible within 1 mile of the target. Examples include "after 1,000 years" or "when the tarrasque awakens." This spell also ends if the target takes any damage.

spells.name: Simulacrum
desc: You shape an illusory duplicate of one beast or humanoid that is within range for the entire casting time of the spell. The duplicate is a creature, partially real and formed from ice or snow, and it can take actions and otherwise be affected as a normal creature. It appears to be the same as the original, but it has half the creature's hit point maximum and is formed without any equipment. Otherwise, the illusion uses all the statistics of the creature it duplicates. The simulacrum is friendly to you and creatures you designate. It obeys your spoken commands, moving and acting in accordance with your wishes and acting on your turn in combat. The simulacrum lacks the ability to learn or become more powerful, so it never increases its level or other abilities, nor can it regain expended spell slots. If the simulacrum is damaged, you can repair it in an alchemical laboratory, using rare herbs and minerals worth 100 gp per hit point it regains. The simulacrum lasts until it drops to 0 hit points, at which point it reverts to snow and melts instantly. If you cast this spell again, any currently active duplicates you created with this spell are instantly destroyed.

Duplikat ini adalah makhluk yang sebagian nyata dan terbentuk dari es atau salju, serta bisa melakukan tindakan dan terpengaruh seperti makhluk normal. Penampilannya sama dengan aslinya, tetapi memiliki maksimum hit point setengah dari makhluk asli dan terbentuk tanpa perlengkapan apa pun. Selain itu, ilusi ini menggunakan semua statistik dari makhluk yang diduplikasi.

- Simulacrum ini bersahabat denganmu dan makhluk yang kamu tunjuk. Ia mematuhi perintah lisanmu, bergerak dan bertindak sesuai keinginanmu, serta bertindak pada giliranmu dalam pertarungan.

spells.name: Symbol
desc: When you cast this spell, you inscribe a harmful glyph either on a surface (such as a section of floor, a wall, or a table) or within an object that can be closed to conceal the glyph (such as a book, a scroll, or a treasure chest). If you choose a surface, the glyph can cover an area of the surface no larger than 10 feet in diameter. If you choose an object, that object must remain in its place; if the object is moved more than 10 feet from where you cast this spell, the glyph is broken, and the spell ends without being triggered. The glyph is nearly invisible, requiring an Intelligence (Investigation) check against your spell save DC to find it. You decide what triggers the glyph when you cast the spell. For glyphs inscribed on a surface, the most typical triggers include touching or stepping on the glyph, removing another object covering it, approaching within a certain distance of it, or manipulating the object that holds it. For glyphs inscribed within an object, the most common triggers are opening the object, approaching within a certain distance of it, or seeing or reading the glyph. You can further refine the trigger so the spell is activated only under certain circumstances or according to a creature's physical characteristics (such as height or weight), or physical kind (for example, the ward could be set to affect hags or shapechangers). You can also specify creatures that don't trigger the glyph, such as those who say a certain password. When you inscribe the glyph, choose one of the options below for its effect. Once triggered, the glyph glows, filling a 60-foot-radius sphere with dim light for 10 minutes, after which time the spell ends. Each creature in the sphere when the glyph activates is targeted by its effect, as is a creature that enters the sphere for the first time on a turn or ends its turn there.
**Death.** Each target must make a constitution saving throw, taking 10d 10 necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful save

**Discord.** Each target must make a constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a target bickers and argues with other creatures for 1 minute. During this time, it is incapable of meaningful communication and has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.

**Fear.** Each target must make a wisdom saving throw and becomes frightened for 1 minute on a failed save. While frightened, the target drops whatever it is holding and must move at least 30 feet away from the glyph on each of its turns, if able.

**Hopelessness.** Each target must make a charisma saving throw. On a failed save, the target is overwhelmed with despair for 1 minute. During this time, it can't attack or target any creature with harmful abilities, spells, or other magical effects.

**Insanity.** Each target must make an intelligence saving throw. On a failed save, the target is driven insane for 1 minute. An insane creature can't take actions, can't understand what other creatures say, can't read, and speaks only in gibberish. The DM controls its movement, which is erratic.
**Pain.** Each target must make a constitution saving throw and becomes incapacitated with excruciating pain for 1 minute on a failed save.

**Sleep.** Each target must make a wisdom saving throw and falls unconscious for 10 minutes on a failed save. A creature awakens if it takes damage or if someone uses an action to shake or slap it awake.
**Stunning.** Each target must make a wisdom saving throw and becomes stunned for 1 minute on a failed save.

Glif ini hampir tidak terlihat dan membutuhkan check Intelligence (Investigation) melawan spell save DC milikmu untuk menemukannya. Kamu menentukan pemicunya saat merapal, seperti menyentuh glif, membuka objek, atau karakteristik makhluk tertentu.

Setelah terpicu, glif akan bersinar dan mengisi bola radius 60 kaki dengan cahaya redup selama 10 menit. Setiap makhluk di dalam bola saat aktivasi, atau makhluk yang masuk atau mengakhiri gilirannya di sana, akan terkena salah satu efek berikut:

- Death: Sasaran harus melakukan Constitution saving throw, menerima **10d10** kerusakan nekrotik jika gagal, atau setengahnya jika berhasil.
- Discord: Sasaran harus melakukan Constitution saving throw. Jika gagal, ia akan bertengkar selama 1 menit, kehilangan kemampuan berkomunikasi dengan jelas, dan mendapatkan disadvantage pada attack rolls dan ability checks.
- Fear: Sasaran harus melakukan Wisdom saving throw. Jika gagal, ia menjadi Takut selama 1 menit, menjatuhkan barang yang dipegang, dan harus menjauh setidaknya 30 kaki dari glif pada setiap gilirannya.
- Hopelessness: Sasaran harus melakukan Charisma saving throw. Jika gagal, ia diliputi keputusasaan selama 1 menit dan tidak bisa menyerang atau menjadikan orang lain sasaran kemampuan berbahaya, sihir, atau efek magis.
- Insanity: Sasaran harus melakukan Intelligence saving throw. Jika gagal, ia menjadi gila selama 1 menit, tidak bisa melakukan action, tidak bisa membaca atau memahami orang lain, dan hanya bicara melantur sementara GM mengontrol pergerakannya yang tidak menentu.
- Pain: Sasaran harus melakukan Constitution saving throw. Jika gagal, ia menjadi Tidak Mampu Bertindak karena rasa sakit yang luar biasa selama 1 menit.
- Sleep: Sasaran harus melakukan Wisdom saving throw. Jika gagal, ia menjadi Tidak Sadar selama 10 menit, dan akan terbangun jika menerima kerusakan atau dibangunkan paksa.
- Stunning: Sasaran harus melakukan Wisdom saving throw. Jika gagal, ia menjadi Pusing selama 1 menit.

spells.name: Teleport
desc: This spell instantly transports you and up to eight willing creatures of your choice that you can see within range, or a single object that you can see within range, to a destination you select. If you target an object, it must be able to fit entirely inside a 10-foot cube, and it can't be held or carried by an unwilling creature. The destination you choose must be known to you, and it must be on the same plane of existence as you. Your familiarity with the destination determines whether you arrive there successfully. The DM rolls d100 and consults the table.

**Familiarity.** "Permanent circle" means a permanent teleportation circle whose sigil sequence you know. "Associated object" means that you possess an object taken from the desired destination within the last six months, such as a book from a wizard's library, bed linen from a royal suite, or a chunk of marble from a lich's secret tomb. "Very familiar" is a place you have been very often, a place you have carefully studied, or a place you can see when you cast the spell. "Seen casually" is someplace you have seen more than once but with which you aren't very familiar. "Viewed once" is a place you have seen once, possibly using magic. "Description" is a place whose location and appearance you know through someone else's description, perhaps from a map. "False destination" is a place that doesn't exist. Perhaps you tried to scry an enemy's sanctum but instead viewed an illusion, or you are attempting to teleport to a familiar location that no longer exists.
**On Target.** You and your group (or the target object) appear where you want to.

**Off Target.** You and your group (or the target object) appear a random distance away from the destination in a random direction. Distance off target is 1d10 × 1d10 percent of the distance that was to be traveled. For example, if you tried to travel 120 miles, landed off target, and rolled a 5 and 3 on the two d10s, then you would be off target by 15 percent, or 18 miles. The GM determines the direction off target randomly by rolling a d8 and designating 1 as north, 2 as northeast, 3 as east, and so on around the points of the compass. If you were teleporting to a coastal city and wound up 18 miles out at sea, you could be in trouble.

**Similar Area.** You and your group (or the target object) wind up in a different area that's visually or thematically similar to the target area. If you are heading for your home laboratory, for example, you might wind up in another wizard's laboratory or in an alchemical supply shop that has many of the same tools and implements as your laboratory. Generally, you appear in the closest similar place, but since the spell has no range limit, you could conceivably wind up anywhere on the plane.

**Mishap.** The spell's unpredictable magic results in a difficult journey. Each teleporting creature (or the target object) takes 3d10 force damage, and the GM rerolls on the table to see where you wind up (multiple mishaps can occur, dealing damage each time).
spells.description:
Sebagai sebuah action, kamu dapat memindahkan dirimu dan hingga delapan makhluk bersedia yang terlihat dalam jangkauan 10 kaki, atau satu objek yang terlihat dalam jangkauan tersebut, ke destinasi di plane yang sama. Objek harus muat dalam kubus 10 kaki dan tidak boleh dipegang oleh makhluk yang tidak bersedia.

Keberhasilan tergantung pada seberapa kenal kamu dengan destinasi tersebut, yang ditentukan melalui roll d100:

- Permanent circle atau Associated object: Selalu tepat sasaran.
- Very familiar: 25% tepat sasaran, 21% meleset, 8% area serupa, 5% kecelakaan.
- Seen casually: 46% tepat sasaran, 10% meleset, 10% area serupa, 33% kecelakaan.
- Viewed once atau Description: 26% tepat sasaran, 20% meleset, 10% area serupa, 43% kecelakaan.
- False destination: 50% area serupa, 50% kecelakaan.

Hasil teleportasi:

- On Target: Kamu tiba tepat di tempat yang dituju.
- Off Target: Kamu muncul di jarak acak. Jarak ini adalah **1d10** x **1d10** persen dari total jarak perjalanan, dengan arah yang ditentukan oleh roll d8.
- Similar Area: Kamu muncul di lokasi terdekat yang secara visual atau tema serupa di plane tersebut.
- Mishap: Setiap makhluk atau objek yang berteleportasi menerima **3d10** kerusakan kekuatan, dan GM mengocok ulang tabel untuk menentukan destinasi akhir; kecelakaan bisa terjadi berulang kali.

Objek harus muat dalam kubus 10 kaki dan tidak boleh dipegang oleh makhluk yang tidak bersedia.

Keberhasilan tergantung pada seberapa kenal kamu dengan destinasi tersebut, yang ditentukan melalui roll d100:

- Permanent circle atau Associated object: Selalu tepat sasaran.
- Very familiar: 25% tepat sasaran, 21% meleset, 8% area serupa, 5% kecelakaan.
- Seen casually: 46% tepat sasaran, 10% meleset, 10% area serupa, 33% kecelakaan.
- Viewed once atau Description: 26% tepat sasaran, 20% meleset, 10% area serupa, 43% kecelakaan.
- False destination: 50% area serupa, 50% kecelakaan.

- On Target: Kamu tiba tepat di tempat yang dituju.
- Off Target: Kamu muncul di jarak acak. Jarak ini adalah **1d10** x **1d10** persen dari total jarak perjalanan, dengan arah yang ditentukan oleh roll d8.

spells.name: Animal Shapes
desc: Your magic turns others into beasts. Choose any number of willing creatures that you can see within range. You transform each target into the form of a Large or smaller beast with a challenge rating of 4 or lower. On subsequent turns, you can use your action to transform affected creatures into new forms.

The transformation lasts for the duration for each target, or until the target drops to 0 hit points or dies. You can choose a different form for each target. A target's game statistics are replaced by the statistics of the chosen beast, though the target retains its alignment and Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores. The target assumes the hit points of its new form, and when it reverts to its normal form, it returns to the number of hit points it had before it transformed. If it reverts as a result of dropping to 0 hit points, any excess damage carries over to its normal form. As long as the excess damage doesn't reduce the creature's normal form to 0 hit points, it isn't knocked unconscious. The creature is limited in the actions it can perform by the nature of its new form, and it can't speak or cast spells.
The target's gear melds into the new form. The target can't activate, wield, or otherwise benefit from any of its equipment.
spells.description:
Menggunakan 1 action, kamu bisa menggunakan sihirmu untuk mengubah sejumlah makhluk yang bersedia yang bisa kamu lihat dalam jarak 30 kaki menjadi binatang. Setiap sasaran berubah menjadi bentuk binatang ukuran Large atau lebih kecil dengan challenge rating 4 atau lebih rendah. Pada giliran-giliran berikutnya, kamu bisa menggunakan action untuk mengubah makhluk yang terpengaruh ke bentuk binatang yang baru.

Transformasi ini bertahan hingga durasi maksimal 24 jam, atau sampai sasaran mencapai 0 hit points atau mati. Kamu bisa memilih bentuk yang berbeda untuk setiap sasaran. Statistik permainan sasaran digantikan oleh statistik binatang yang dipilih, namun sasaran tetap mempertahankan alignment serta skor Intelligence, Wisdom, dan Charisma miliknya.

- Sasaran menggunakan hit points dari bentuk barunya. Saat kembali ke bentuk normal, hit points-nya kembali ke jumlah sebelum transformasi.
- Jika transformasi berakhir karena mencapai 0 hit points, sisa kerusakan yang berlebih akan terbawa ke bentuk normalnya. Selama sisa kerusakan tersebut tidak membuat bentuk normalnya mencapai 0 hit points, makhluk itu tidak menjadi tidak sadar.
- Makhluk tersebut dibatasi dalam action yang bisa dilakukan sesuai dengan sifat bentuk barunya, serta tidak bisa berbicara atau merapal sihir.
- Perlengkapan sasaran menyatu ke dalam bentuk baru, sehingga sasaran tidak bisa mengaktifkan, menggunakan, atau mendapatkan manfaat dari perlengkapannya.

spells.name: Antimagic Field
desc: A 10-foot-radius invisible sphere of antimagic surrounds you. This area is divorced from the magical energy that suffuses the multiverse. Within the sphere, spells can't be cast, summoned creatures disappear, and even magic items become mundane. Until the spell ends, the sphere moves with you, centered on you. Spells and other magical effects, except those created by an artifact or a deity, are suppressed in the sphere and can't protrude into it. A slot expended to cast a suppressed spell is consumed. While an effect is suppressed, it doesn't function, but the time it spends suppressed counts against its duration.
**Targeted Effects.** Spells and other magical effects, such as magic missile and charm person, that target a creature or an object in the sphere have no effect on that target.

**Areas of Magic.** The area of another spell or magical effect, such as fireball, can't extend into the sphere. If the sphere overlaps an area of magic, the part of the area that is covered by the sphere is suppressed. For example, the flames created by a wall of fire are suppressed within the sphere, creating a gap in the wall if the overlap is large enough.
**Spells.** Any active spell or other magical effect on a creature or an object in the sphere is suppressed while the creature or object is in it.

**Magic Items.** The properties and powers of magic items are suppressed in the sphere. For example, a +1 longsword in the sphere functions as a nonmagical longsword. A magic weapon's properties and powers are suppressed if it is used against a target in the sphere or wielded by an attacker in the sphere. If a magic weapon or a piece of magic ammunition fully leaves the sphere (for example, if you fire a magic arrow or throw a magic spear at a target outside the sphere), the magic of the item ceases to be suppressed as soon as it exits.

**Magical Travel.** Teleportation and planar travel fail to work in the sphere, whether the sphere is the destination or the departure point for such magical travel. A portal to another location, world, or plane of existence, as well as an opening to an extradimensional space such as that created by the rope trick spell, temporarily closes while in the sphere.

**Creatures and Objects.** A creature or object summoned or created by magic temporarily winks out of existence in the sphere. Such a creature instantly reappears once the space the creature occupied is no longer within the sphere.
**Dispel Magic.** Spells and magical effects such as dispel magic have no effect on the sphere. Likewise, the spheres created by different antimagic field spells don't nullify each other.

spells.description:
Sebagai 1 action, kamu menciptakan bola antimagic tak terlihat beradius 10 kaki yang berpusat pada dirimu dan bergerak bersamamu selama durasi maksimal 1 jam. Di dalam bola ini, sihir tidak bisa dirapal, makhluk yang dipanggil akan menghilang, dan item magis menjadi benda biasa. Sihir dan efek magis lainnya, kecuali yang diciptakan oleh artifact atau dewa, akan tertekan di dalam bola dan tidak bisa menembus masuk ke dalamnya. Slot sihir yang digunakan untuk merapal sihir yang tertekan tetap terpakai; selama tertekan, efeknya tidak berfungsi, tetapi waktu yang dihabiskan saat tertekan tetap dihitung dalam durasinya.

- Efek Terarah: Sihir dan efek magis lainnya, seperti magic missile dan charm person, yang menargetkan makhluk atau objek di dalam bola tidak akan memberikan efek pada sasaran tersebut.
- Area Magis: Area dari sihir atau efek magis lain, seperti fireball, tidak bisa masuk ke dalam bola. Jika bola ini tumpang tindih dengan area magis, bagian yang tertutup akan tertekan (misalnya, menciptakan celah pada wall of fire).
- Sihir: Setiap sihir aktif atau efek magis lainnya pada makhluk atau objek di dalam bola akan tertekan selama makhluk atau objek tersebut berada di dalamnya.
- Item Magis: Properti dan kekuatan item magis tertekan. Pedang longsword +1 akan berfungsi sebagai longsword nonmagis. Kekuatan senjata magis tertekan jika digunakan melawan sasaran di dalam bola atau digunakan oleh penyerang yang berada di dalam bola. Jika senjata atau amunisi magis sepenuhnya keluar dari bola, efek tekanannya hilang.
- Perjalanan Magis: Teleportasi dan perjalanan antar-plane gagal berfungsi di dalam bola, baik sebagai titik tujuan maupun titik keberangkatan. Portal ke lokasi, dunia, atau plane lain, serta pintu masuk ke ruang extradimensional (seperti yang diciptakan oleh sihir rope trick), akan tertutup sementara.
- Makhluk dan Objek: Makhluk atau objek yang dipanggil atau diciptakan oleh sihir akan menghilang sementara di dalam bola dan muncul kembali setelah ruang yang ditempatinya tidak lagi berada di dalam bola.
- Dispel Magic: Sihir dan efek magis seperti dispel magic tidak berpengaruh pada bola ini, dan bola yang diciptakan oleh sihir antimagic field yang berbeda tidak saling meniadakan.

spells.name: Antipathy/Sympathy
desc: This spell attracts or repels creatures of your choice. You target something within range, either a Huge or smaller object or creature or an area that is no larger than a 200-foot cube. Then specify a kind of intelligent creature, such as red dragons, goblins, or vampires. You invest the target with an aura that either attracts or repels the specified creatures for the duration. Choose antipathy or sympathy as the aura's effect.

***Antipathy.*** The enchantment causes creatures of the kind you designated to feel an intense urge to leave the area and avoid the target. When such a creature can see the target or comes within 60 feet of it, the creature must succeed on a wisdom saving throw or become frightened. The creature remains frightened while it can see the target or is within 60 feet of it. While frightened by the target, the creature must use its movement to move to the nearest safe spot from which it can't see the target. If the creature moves more than 60 feet from the target and can't see it, the creature is no longer frightened, but the creature becomes frightened again if it regains sight of the target or moves within 60 feet of it.

***Sympathy.*** The enchantment causes the specified creatures to feel an intense urge to approach the target while within 60 feet of it or able to see it. When such a creature can see the target or comes within 60 feet of it, the creature must succeed on a wisdom saving throw or use its movement on each of its turns to enter the area or move within reach of the target. When the creature has done so, it can't willingly move away from the target.
If the target damages or otherwise harms an affected creature, the affected creature can make a wisdom saving throw to end the effect, as described below.

***Ending the Effect.*** If an affected creature ends its turn while not within 60 feet of the target or able to see it, the creature makes a wisdom saving throw. On a successful save, the creature is no longer affected by the target and recognizes the feeling of repugnance or attraction as magical. In addition, a creature affected by the spell is allowed another wisdom saving throw every 24 hours while the spell persists.
A creature that successfully saves against this effect is immune to it for 1 minute, after which time it can be affected again.

spells.name: Clone
desc: This spell grows an inert duplicate of a living creature as a safeguard against death. This clone forms inside a sealed vessel and grows to full size and maturity after 120 days; you can also choose to have the clone be a younger version of the same creature. It remains inert and endures indefinitely, as long as its vessel remains undisturbed. At any time after the clone matures, if the original creature dies, its soul transfers to the clone, provided that the soul is free and willing to return. The clone is physically identical to the original and has the same personality, memories, and abilities, but none of the original's equipment. The original creature's physical remains, if they still exist, become inert and can't thereafter be restored to life, since the creature's soul is elsewhere.

components.materialDesc: A diamond worth at least 1,000 gp and at least 1 cubic inch of flesh of the creature that is to be cloned, which the spell consumes, and a vessel worth at least 2,000 gp that has a sealable lid and is large enough to hold a Medium creature, such as a huge urn, coffin, mud-filled cyst in the ground, or crystal container filled with salt water.

spells.description:
Dengan waktu perapalan 1 jam dan jangkauan sentuhan, kamu menumbuhkan duplikat tidak aktif dari makhluk hidup di dalam wadah tertutup. Kloning ini akan tumbuh hingga ukuran penuh dan dewasa setelah 120 hari, meskipun kamu bisa memilih agar ia menjadi versi yang lebih muda. spells.name: Control Weather
desc: You take control of the weather within 5 miles of you for the duration. You must be outdoors to cast this spell. Moving to a place where you don't have a clear path to the sky ends the spell early. When you cast the spell, you change the current weather conditions, which are determined by the DM based on the climate and season. You can change precipitation, temperature, and wind. It takes 1d4 x 10 minutes for the new conditions to take effect. Once they do so, you can change the conditions again. When the spell ends, the weather gradually returns to normal. When you change the weather conditions, find a current condition on the following tables and change its stage by one, up or down. When changing the wind, you can change its direction.

spells.name: Demiplane
desc: You create a shadowy door on a flat solid surface that you can see within range. The door is large enough to allow Medium creatures to pass through unhindered. When opened, the door leads to a demiplane that appears to be an empty room 30 feet in each dimension, made of wood or stone. When the spell ends, the door disappears, and any creatures or objects inside the demiplane remain trapped there, as the door also disappears from the other side. Each time you cast this spell, you can create a new demiplane, or have the shadowy door connect to a demiplane you created with a previous casting of this spell. Additionally, if you know the nature and contents of a demiplane created by a casting of this spell by another creature, you can have the shadowy door connect to its demiplane instead.
spells.description:
Sebagai sebuah action, kamu menciptakan pintu bayangan pada permukaan padat datar yang bisa kamu lihat dalam jarak 60 kaki. Pintu ini cukup besar untuk dilewati makhluk ukuran Medium tanpa hambatan. Saat dibuka, pintu ini menuju ke sebuah demiplane yang tampak seperti ruangan kosong berukuran 30 kaki di setiap dimensinya, terbuat dari kayu atau batu.

Ketika sihir berakhir setelah 1 jam, pintu tersebut menghilang, dan setiap makhluk atau objek di dalam demiplane akan terjebak di sana karena pintu tersebut juga menghilang dari sisi dalam.

Setiap kali kamu merapal sihir ini, kamu bisa:
- Menciptakan demiplane baru.
- Membuat pintu bayangan terhubung ke demiplane yang pernah kamu buat dengan perapalan sebelumnya.
- Terhubung ke demiplane yang diciptakan oleh makhluk lain, asalkan kamu mengetahui sifat dan isi dari demiplane tersebut.

spells.name: Dominate Monster
desc: You attempt to beguile a creature that you can see within range. It must succeed on a wisdom saving throw or be charmed by you for the duration. If you or creatures that are friendly to you are fighting it, it has advantage on the saving throw. While the creature is charmed, you have a telepathic link with it as long as the two of you are on the same plane of existence. You can use this telepathic link to issue commands to the creature while you are conscious (no action required), which it does its best to obey. You can specify a simple and general course of action, such as "Attack that creature," "Run over there," or "Fetch that object." If the creature completes the order and doesn't receive further direction from you, it defends and preserves itself to the best of its ability. You can use your action to take total and precise control of the target. Until the end of your next turn, the creature takes only the actions you choose, and doesn't do anything that you don't allow it to do. During this time, you can also cause the creature to use a reaction, but this requires you to use your own reaction as well. Each time the target takes damage, it makes a new wisdom saving throw against the spell. If the saving throw succeeds, the spell ends.
higher_level: When you cast this spell with a 9th-level spell slot, the duration is concentration, up to 8 hours.

dc.desc: On failure, the creature is charmed by you for the duration.

spells.description: Kamu mencoba memikat seekor Creature yang kamu lihat dalam jangkauan. Ia harus berhasil pada Wisdom saving throw atau menjadi Charmed olehmu selama durasi. Jika kamu atau makhluk yang bersahabat denganku sedang melawannya, ia memiliki Advantage pada saving throw. Selama Creature tersebut Charmed, kamu memiliki Telepathic link dengannya selama kalian berada di Plane of Existence yang sama. Kamu bisa menggunakan link ini untuk mengeluarkan perintah ke makhluk tersebut saat kamu Sadar (tidak memerlukan Action), yang akan ia ikuti sebaik mungkin. Kamu bisa menentukan tindakan sederhana dan umum, seperti "Serang makhluk itu," "Lari ke sana," atau "Ambil objek itu." Jika makhluk menyelesaikan perintah dan tidak menerima arahan lebih lanjut, ia akan bertahan dan mempertahankan dirinya. Kamu bisa menggunakan Actionmu untuk mengambil kendali total dan presisi atas target. Hingga akhir giliranmu berikutnya, makhluk hanya melakukan Action yang kamu pilih, dan tidak melakukan apa pun yang tidak kamu izinkan. Selama ini, kamu juga bisa memaksa makhluk menggunakan Reaction, tapi ini memerlukan Reactionmu sendiri. Setiap kali target menerima Damage, ia melakukan Wisdom saving throw baru. Jika berhasil, spell berakhir.
